jobs.title: Product Trust Process Architect (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Location:
Garching \- Bavaria, Germany \- Parking 1\-5 Business Campus
Job Family:
Digital
Worker Type Reference:
Regular \- Permanent
Pay Rate Type:
Salary
Career Level:
P4
Job ID:
R\-55245\-2026
  
### **Description \& Requirements**


**About the Role**


This role will report to the Product Trust Governance \& Compliance Director. As the Product Trust Process Architect, you will define, maintain, and continuously improve the Harman Cybersecurity Management System (CSMS) and its underlying processes, work instructions, templates, guidelines, and checklists on the Harman Business Management System (BMS). You will maintain the CSMS and represent Harman's CSMS during internal and external audits. Within the broader Product Trust framework, you will also support alignment with Functional Safety (FUSA), applicable SOTIF, and responsible AI governance. You will collaborate closely with engineering, quality, procurement, data privacy, and learning functions to embed cybersecurity governance and a strong cybersecurity culture across the organization.


**What You Will Do**


* Define and improve Cybersecurity\-specific processes, work instructions, templates, guidelines, and checklists on BMS.
* Lead the rollout and deployment of the CSMS across all SBUs, managing the organizational change required to embed cybersecurity processes into day\-to\-day engineering operations and drive adoption.
* Monitor the evolving global cybersecurity regulatory landscape (UNECE R155/R156, EU Cyber Resilience Act, regional and OEM\-specific requirements) and translate changes into HARMAN's cybersecurity compliance strategy, roadmap, and process updates.
* Present the details of Harman CSMS in internal audits, customer audit, and certification audits.
* Define, track, and report CSMS performance metrics and KPIs through governance dashboards and management reviews, driving data\-based continuous improvement of the CSMS.
* Interface with Harman Learning and Development to define \& conduct cybersecurity training programs and identify external trainers for cybersecurity courses.
* Participate in the industry cybersecurity community to learn and adopt best practices.
* Benchmark Harman's CSMS and cybersecurity governance practices against industry peers, OEMs, and Tier\-1 competitors to identify differentiators and improvement opportunities.
* Analyze audit findings, non\-conformities, and industry lessons learned from multiple sources to define corrective and preventive actions for the CSMS.
* Support the internal Assessor in reviewing the cybersecurity assessment report prior to its finalization, ensuring completeness, consistency, and alignment with ISO/SAE 21434\.

**What You Need to Be Successful**


* 8\+ years of engineering experience in embedded automotive systems, systems engineering, or Product Trust, or PhD with \+5 years of experience in a related field.
* Minimum master’s degree in computer science, Electrical Engineering, Cybersecurity or a relevant technical discipline. Advanced degrees are highly preferred.
* Expert in Automotive Cybersecurity Engineering (ISO/SAE 21434\).
* Knowledge of UNECE R155 and R156 regulations.
* Experience / familiarity with the Product Development Life Cycle.
* Experience / familiarity with data privacy regulations, e.g., GDPR, CCPA, etc.
* Knowledge of tool management rules.
* Knowledge of process reference models such as Automotive SPICE®, TISAX, ISO 26262, and IATF 16949\.
* Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Proficiency in on site native language

**Bonus Points if You Have**

* Prior experience in defining and maintaining CSMS on the organization level.
* Experience representing an organization's CSMS in ISO/SAE 21434, UNECE R155 / R156, TISAX, or Automotive SPICE for Cybersecurity audits and assessments.
* Knowledge of and experience with Automotive Functional Safety (ISO 26262\), including safety\-by\-design principles and functional safety management.
* Familiarity with SOTIF (ISO 21448\) and its interaction with cybersecurity and functional safety.
* Experience contributing to or maintaining a Functional Safety Management System and supporting functional safety assessments
* Awareness of responsible AI / AI trustworthiness considerations for automotive products.
* Experience conducting supplier cybersecurity capability assessments and third\-party risk management. Experience defining and delivering cybersecurity awareness and training programs.
* Membership in an automotive cybersecurity working group, consortium, or standards body.
* Experience with IoT / embedded systems security.

**What Makes You Eligible**


* Be willing to travel up to 10%, domestic and international travel
* Be willing to work in an office, client\-site in 1 location

**What We Offer**

* Flexible work schedule with a culture encouraging work life integration and collaboration in a global friendly working atmosphere and good work\-life\-balance
* Access to employee discounts on world\-class Harman and Samsung products (JBL, HARMAN Kardon, AKG, etc.)
* Extensive training opportunities through our own HARMAN University
* Competitive wellness benefits
* Tuition reimbursement
* “Be Brilliant” employee recognition and rewards program
* An inclusive and diverse work environment that fosters and encourages professional and personal development

\#LI\-NR3
  

\#LI\-Hybrid


**About HARMAN: Where Innovation Unleashes Next\-Level Technology**
Ever since the 1920s, we’ve been amplifying the sense of sound. Today, that legacy endures, with integrated technology platforms that make the world smarter, safer, and more connected.

**The opportunity**
-------------------


Make Unity run everywhere! That is the mantra of the Embedded OS Platforms team. Users expect stunning interactive experiences everywhere: from in\-car infotainment systems and digital cockpits to touch\-screen kiosks in showrooms and at sporting events. Unity is at the forefront with our scalable, performant runtime engine and Unity Editor workflow.


We are looking for a senior software engineer to join our growing team. The team builds and supports the Unity versions that run on Embedded platforms, like Embedded Linux, QNX and Android Automotive OS. As UX evolves to include multiple screens, layering of 3D content with other applications and rich multi\-touch input, our platform grows to match expectations.


Unity is committed to solving the hardest technical challenges, and this role plays a key part in delivering industry solutions for our customers. You will work with teams across Unity, including industry teams who work directly with customers and R\&D teams responsible for cross\-platform support, systems architecture, libraries, as well as runtime optimization.

**What success looks like**
---------------------------


In your first 3\-6 months, you've ramped up on one of our embedded platforms, shipped your first integrations and bug fixes, and become a trusted contributor in customer\-facing investigations.


Within 12 months, you own a meaningful area of a platform (e.g. AAOS integration) its performance on constrained embedded SoCs and act as a technical point of contact for one of our customers. You guide team wide initiatives with your experience and expertise.

**Your impact**
---------------


You'll be part of a small, senior team with a strong impact. The code you write ships in production vehicles, and your work directly unblocks Unity's embedded and automotive business. You'll help define the technical bar across the team and shape how Unity supports the next generation of software\-defined vehicles.

**Why you'll love it**
----------------------


Genuinely hard problems at the frontier of Real Time 3D and embedded systems. Contribution to cutting edge automotive HMI experiences. A diverse range of responsibilities spanning feature work and customer support. Real ownership, agency and opportunities to grow in a small and senior team that turns the needle and moves the industry forward.

**What you'll be doing**
------------------------

* Bring Unity's Real Time 3D runtime to embedded platforms, like Embedded Linux, QNX and Android Automotive OS, developing new features and integrations that address the needs of industries like the automotive HMI market.
* Build the graphics and windowing layer that powers multi\-screen, multi\-touch digital cockpits and HMIs.
* Profile and optimize KPI like runtime performance, memory, startup/load time and iteration speed of Unity for resource\-constrained embedded SoCs across platforms.
* Partner directly with customers like automotive OEMs as a technical point of contact, investigating issues, removing performance bottlenecks, and setting customers up for production success.
* Raise the engineering bar for a small and senior team through design discussions, code reviews, and automated testing .

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* Languages: Proficiency in C/C\+\+/C\# and building scalable feature sets in a large multithreaded codebase.
* Embedded Platforms: Experience developing for Embedded Linux, QNX and hypervised environments.
* Graphics Engineering: Experience developing against Vulkan and OpenGL ES applied to Real Time 3D and UI rendering.
* Performance optimization: Profiling and optimization on resource\-constrained hardware using CPU/GPU/IO tooling.
* Customer collaboration: Working directly with customers on technical issues, with business\-level English.
* Team influence: Become an established senior engineer who guides the team on large cross\-platform initiatives.

**You might also have**
-----------------------

* Experience working with or developing Real Time 3D game engines (Unity, Unreal, Godot).
* Hands\-on game development experience.
* Experience developing for embedded and automotive SoC (Qualcomm SA8295/SA8775P, NXP i.MX8/i.MX95, NVIDIA Jetson/DRIVE Orin).
* Experience working on automotive HMI (cluster, infotainment, ADAS, map navigation).
* Android platform: Hands\-on AAOS or AOSP development experience on the platform layer, experience integrating into the Android lifecycle as well as using the Android compositing stack (SurfaceFlinger, HWComposer, Gralloc, EGL).

UK Zone A 55,700 \- 83,500 GBP


UK Zone B 63,700 \- 95,500 GBP

Working with colleagues across CoolCare, LNT and Crystal Care, you’ll turn real operational needs into useful, straightforward features. You’ll investigate issues, improve existing functionality and help keep our applications reliable and secure.

You’ll be involved throughout the development process, from understanding what users need through to development, testing and release. As part of a small new team, you’ll also have plenty of opportunity to influence how we approach the code, data, configuration and longer\-term development of the products.

We’re looking for someone with experience in building applications that manage data and business processes. Experience limited to brochure websites, landing pages or CMS page building will not be sufficient for this role.

**Technical Skills**

* Experience building and maintaining production web applications using modern frontend frameworks and languages, including React and Typescript.
* Experience using cloud services for application hosting, authentication and server\-side processing.
* Familiarity with deployments, permissions, logging and troubleshooting in cloud environments.
* Experience working with relational and/or document databases, including data modelling, querying and secure access controls.
* Familiarity with Agile working, version control, code reviews and automated testing.

**Desirable experience**

Experience with any of the following would be useful:

* Experience with other web application technologies, such as Vue.js, Angular, Node.js or .NET.
* Firebase, including Firestore, Authentication, Hosting and Functions.
* AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud.
* SQL Server or Azure SQL.
* Configurable forms, reports or workflows.
* Building or integrating APIs.
* CI/CD and deployment automation.
* Experience using AI coding assistants to support development, debugging, testing or code review.
* Handling sensitive personal data or developing software for the care sector or similar.

**Application Process**

Our two\-stage process starts with a conversation about your experience and the role, followed by a practical programming session where you'll work through a small application with one of our developers. We expect to hold both stages during a single visit to our office.

Pay: £40,000\.00\-£45,000\.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Garforth LS25

jobs.title: Senior Integration and Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Location: Bristol or Manchester hybrid (regular travel to partner sites across the UK and Ireland as needed)  

Role Type: Permanent (full\-time preferred, flexible working considered)

  

About PACT Solutions:


PACT Solutions is a specialist management and digital transformation consultancy working exclusively with higher education institutions across the UK.


We help universities solve complex challenges across strategy, student records, data, change and delivery. Our work often sits at the heart of major institutional transformation, helping partners improve the student journey, modernise operations and deliver change more effectively.


PACT has grown quickly and is now entering its next phase. We are moving from a founder\-led boutique consultancy into a more scaled and structured business, while protecting the quality, culture and partner focus that have made us successful.


Our culture is crucial to our success. Each day, our team significantly contributes to our business and that of our partners.


We combine the agility and collaborative spirit of a close\-knit consultancy with the credibility, structure, and professionalism needed to deliver meaningful digital transformation.


Our values sit at the heart of everything we do and are core to our business.

  

Partnership: We work with you, not for you.


Integrity: We do the right thing, even when it requires difficult conversations.


Curiosity: We dig deeper to uncover what will truly deliver value.


Transformation: We focus on outcomes that create lasting, measurable improvement.

  

The Role


We are looking for a Senior Integration and Solution Architect to own the architecture of data integration solutions across our higher education partners. You will define the integration framework: the principles, patterns, standards and technical decisions that determine what is built and how it is built.


This is an architecture role, not a day\-to\-day delivery management role. Working alongside colleagues who lead programme and technical delivery, you will provide the architectural direction and assurance that enable secure, resilient and maintainable integrations across complex transformation programmes.


You will combine strong consulting skills with practical experience of Azure Integration Services and software engineering. You will shape target\-state architectures, guide solution design and support teams to apply consistent, reusable approaches.

  

Purpose of the role


To support the delivery of effective, practical and people\-centred change activity that helps PACT’s partners adopt new systems, processes and ways of working successfully.

  

Key Responsibilities


1\. Integration and solution architecture

* Own the integration architecture for assigned partner programmes and shape the target\-state integration landscape.
* Define and evolve integration principles, reference architectures, patterns, standards and reusable components.
* Translate business, data and operational requirements into clear solution architectures, design decisions and technical roadmaps.
* Set the approach to API design, data contracts, message design, asynchronous processing, error handling, security, observability and resilience.
* Assess architectural options and technical trade\-offs, providing clear recommendations to partners and delivery teams.


2\. Solution design and technical assurance

* Design practical, scalable and maintainable integrations using Azure Integration Services, including Azure Service Bus, APIs and related Azure services.
* Provide architectural assurance at key design, build, test and deployment points, ensuring solutions conform to agreed standards.
* Review technical designs, code and documentation to improve consistency, quality and long\-term supportability.
* Support the resolution of complex integration issues and design risks, focusing on root cause and sustainable architectural outcomes.


3\. Stakeholder and consulting leadership

* Lead architecture workshops, discovery sessions and design forums with senior business and technical stakeholders.
* Build trusted relationships with stakeholders up to Head of Service and senior manager level.
* Explain complex technical concepts in clear business language and challenge constructively where decisions create avoidable risk or compromise.
* Work closely with programme, product, data and technical delivery colleagues so architectural decisions are understood and actionable.


4\. Capability development

* Develop PACT's integration framework, methodologies, standards, reusable assets and propositions.
* Coach consultants and engineers in sound integration design and engineering practice.
* Contribute to internal knowledge sharing and the continued development of PACT's Data Integration capability.


What we offer

* + The opportunity to shape integration architecture across major higher education transformation programmes.
* + Work with Azure Integration Services, Azure Service Bus, Python and .NET in complex enterprise environments.
* + Development of consulting, architecture and technical capability.
* + A clear progression path through PACT's consulting career pathway, including Principal\-level opportunities.
* + The opportunity to shape PACT's Data Integration capability.


This role sits at the Senior Consultant within PACT’s consulting career pathway (Analyst Consultant Senior Consultant Lead Principal), providing a strong foundation to develop core consulting and delivery skills.

 **Requirements**  

Essential experience

* Significant experience as an Integration Architect, Solution Architect or similar senior architecture role in complex enterprise environments.
* Strong integration architecture capability, including API design, messaging patterns, asynchronous processing, event\-driven integration and data contracts.
* Ability to define architectural principles, standards, patterns and reusable components, and apply them across multiple systems and teams.
* Hands\-on experience with Azure Integration Services, particularly Azure Service Bus, APIs and related Azure services.
* Strong Python and/or .NET development capability, with experience building or assuring production\-grade integration services.
* Ability to design secure, scalable and maintainable integrations, including observability, error handling, resilience and supportability.
* Experience facilitating architecture workshops, communicating technical trade\-offs and influencing senior stakeholders.
* Experience reviewing and assuring technical designs, documentation and engineering outputs.

  

Desirable

* Experience within higher education.
* Experience integrating enterprise platforms such as SIS, ERP, CRM and VLE systems.
* Experience with Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, source control and automated testing.
* Experience in consultancy or transformation environments.

  

**Benefits**  

PACT offers a flexible and supportive approach to work, including hybrid and flexible working arrangements. Our benefits package includes enhanced pension contributions, an annual bonus and enhanced parental leave, helping our people balance a rewarding career with the commitments that matter to them.

jobs.title: Graduate Programme 2027 - Facade Engineering - London
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

Turner \& Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.  

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.  

Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.  

We are majority\-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner \& Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.  

Please visit our website: www.turnerandtownsend.com


We transform together \| Turner \& Townsend

 **Job Description**  

Our 24\-month Graduate Development Programme (GDP) provides you with a learning environment to help you become a well\-rounded consultant and launch your career.


From day one, you’ll dive into the heart of Turner \& Townsend, building your internal networks and deepening your understanding of our industry and service area. This is your chance to develop industry knowledge that goes beyond textbooks and lectures!


As a part of our team, you’ll receive a structured development plan tailored to introduce you to the technical and commercial competencies that are the steppingstones to success at Turner \& Townsend. A dedicated Graduate Development Manager will be your guide, providing support and ensuring you’re on the right track.


Our learning approach goes beyond traditional ‘on\-the\-job’ training. You’ll benefit from a blend of technical and behavioural training, learning from both peers and experienced professionals. This comprehensive approach equips you with the knowledge and skills you need to excel.


We are committed to your continuous learning and professional development, and we offer opportunities to pursue professional qualifications with esteemed institutions. Are you ready to embark on a journey that will shape your career and future? Join us at Turner \& Townsend and make the difference!

**Façade engineering** blends artistry, science, and engineering to create effective, visually appealing, and sustainable building enclosures. The performance of a building's exterior walls is crucial, significantly impacting its functionality and overall value. It's a complex and high\-stakes area, and at CBRE, our team of façade experts and engineering specialists are at the forefront, ensuring optimal and sustainable performance.


This two\-year program is designed for ambitious graduates looking to specialize in Façade Engineering. We support your professional growth and offer opportunities to gain an MSc in Façade Engineering through UWE or towards your membership with the Society of Façade Engineering.


As a Façade Engineer, you will be responsible for a range of tasks, including but not limited to:

* Investigating and diagnosing façade issues through detailed inspections.
* Contributing to effective maintenance and replacement strategies.
* Advising on design and performance metrics.
* Guiding clients on compliance, risk management, and achieving ambitious environmental standards, maximizing value.

 **What You’ll Gain**

* Sector Exposure: The opportunity to broaden your knowledge across sectors such as real estate, infrastructure, advisory, defence, and energy and natural resources while developing the skills to provide commercial, strategic, and analytical advice to clients.
* Client and Team Engagement:The opportunity to work with your colleagues in a team environment, and with our clients, to drive positive social and environmental change, encourage innovation and create a sustainable energy future.
* Tailored Development: A personalised training plan designed to grow your skills and knowledge, with tools to help you track and advance your progress.
* Technical Training: Access to our Technical Training Academy, where you’ll deepen your professional expertise, sharpen your capabilities, and prepare for future challenges.
* Supportive Culture: A collaborative team environment that actively supports your development and helps you grow your career as a professional.
* Global Opportunity: The chance to join a high\-performing, global professional services firm known for its resilience and adaptability in changing market conditions.
* Purpose\-Driven Work: Opportunities to contribute to our commitments in sustainability, innovation, inclusivity, wellbeing, and community impact.

 **Qualifications**  

* Academic Credentials: A degree in the one of the following subjects: Architectural Technology, Architectural Engineering, Building Physics, Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering (achieved or on track for a 2:1 minimum) or an MSc in Façade Engineering.
* Technical Acumen: An understanding of the technical aspects of building surveying, coupled with a genuine interest in the real estate and built environment.

 **Additional Information** **Benefits**

* 25 Days annual leave
* Buy and Sell annual leave
* Corporate Gym Membership
* Cycle scheme
* Pension

 **Other Requirements**

*In some regional roles, the ability to drive may be necessary due to the location of client offices.*


To be considered for roles in the Defence arena, you will need to pass both a Baseline Personnel Security Standard check and UKSV SC clearance. This process will begin once you’ve accepted an offer and confirmed your willingness to undergo the checks.

The role requires strong design ability, sound professional judgement, excellent communication and the capacity to manage multiple projects and competing demands.

**Your new role**


Sitting within the Housing, Neighbourhoods and Building Services directorate, you will report to the Landscape Architect Team Leader and support the Principal Architect in delivering the Council’s capital projects and professional design services. The Design Team is multidisciplinary and includes architects and landscape architects. The team works closely with building surveyors, quantity surveyors, engineers, construction inspectors, project managers and internal and external consultants to deliver project outcomes.


The team provides services across the Council and to external organisations. Clients and stakeholders may include Housing, Education, Planning, Highways, Parks, Regeneration, Culture, Leisure, Public Health and Property services, together with schools, academy trusts, NHS bodies, charities and neighbouring authorities. Projects may include schools, housing estates, parks, streets and public realm, civic and operational property, regeneration sites, heritage settings and externally commissioned work. You will balance design quality and environmental outcomes with statutory, financial, operational, political and community requirements.


Please see the full job profile attached at the bottom of this page for all details of what the role will involve!

**Who is the person?**


The ideal candidate is someone who:

* Holds an undergraduate honours degree or postgraduate degree, or equivalent, in landscape architecture or a closely related discipline that provides the professional knowledge required for the role.
* Chartered Membership of the Landscape Institute is preferred but is not essential. Applicants who are not chartered must demonstrate extensive relevant professional experience and competence equivalent to undertaking the full duties of the role independently, with willingness to pursue chartership.
* Have at least three years of relevant professional experience and a record of independently delivering significant or medium\-scale landscape, public realm, regeneration or environmental improvement projects.
* Demonstrate strong landscape design ability and the capacity to analyse a place, identify constraints and opportunities, develop creative options and communicate a coherent design response.
* Have expert knowledge of landscape planning, hard and soft landscape design, construction detailing, specification, procurement, contract administration, construction and aftercare.
* Have practical knowledge of planning and environmental requirements, including biodiversity net gain, sustainable drainage, green infrastructure, accessibility, trees, ecology, heritage and relevant health and safety duties.
* Have experience of working within and, where required, leading multidisciplinary professional teams and coordinating the input of clients, consultants, contractors and statutory bodies.
* Have experience of preparing tender information, assessing submissions, administering construction contracts, inspecting works, managing defects and protecting the client’s contractual position.
* Demonstrate commercial awareness and experience of project budgets, professional fees, cost planning, tender evaluation, valuations, change control, forecasting, risk management and value for money.
* Have excellent written, verbal, visual and interpersonal communication skills, including the ability to prepare clear reports and presentations, chair meetings, consult communities, negotiate and resolve disagreement.
* Be able to build trusted relationships with internal and external clients, understand their requirements, manage expectations and keep stakeholders informed throughout the project lifecycle.
* Be organised, resilient and comfortable managing multiple projects, deadlines and changing priorities while maintaining accuracy, professional standards and attention to detail.
* Be proficient in AutoCAD and relevant design, visualisation and presentation software, together with NBS or equivalent specification systems and Microsoft 365 applications.

**About Portsmouth City Council**


Portsmouth City Council is a unique organisation, committed to making a difference, and is guided by core values that set who we are as people, what we stand for, and how we act.


We are committed to our values of respect, integrity, collaboration, inclusivity and being people\-focussed. These values set out how we can contribute to the success of the council and our own success as individuals. Learn more about our values and behaviours.

**Our recruitment process**


Full information about our recruitment process can be found on our support for applicants' page: Support for applicants \- Careers portal

This might be through qualifications or descriptive examples from your work / personal experience, which clearly illustrates what you did and the effect it had. **If you apply without a detailed personal statement, it is unlikely that you will be successful.**

**Digital Developer**

**Location: London Bridge**

**Hybrid, 2 days per week on\-site**  

**Full time, 37\.5 hours per week, Monday\-Friday**  

**Permanent**


We are seeking a talented and experienced Sitecore Developer to join our Digital IT team. The successful candidate will be responsible for the development, maintenance, enhancement, and optimisation of enterprise\-level websites and digital platforms built on the Sitecore Experience Platform (XP) and associated Microsoft technologies.


Working closely with Digital Product Owners, UX Designers, Digital Marketing teams, and technical stakeholders, you will deliver scalable, high\-performing digital solutions that provide exceptional customer experiences while supporting business objectives.


This role is ideal for someone who enjoys both project\-based development and ongoing support of business\-critical digital platforms.

**Above all else, we’re committed to the care and improvement of human life. It’s this guiding vision that influences everything we do at HCA UK. From the CEO to the colleagues on the floor we all have a part to play in delivering exceptional care to our patients. Others may think this is just a role in Digital IT, but to us, you’ll be part of a wider team with a unique sense of purpose, one that helps improve lives on a daily basis.**

**What you’ll do:**

* Design, develop and maintain websites and digital applications using Sitecore.
* Build reusable Sitecore components, templates, rendering items and workflows.
* Develop custom integrations between Sitecore and third\-party systems, APIs, CRM platforms and Microsoft services.
* Participate in the full software development lifecycle from requirements gathering through QA, deployment and support.
* Provide ongoing support, troubleshooting, upgrades and enhancements for existing Sitecore environments.
* Collaborate with UX, Digital Marketing and technical teams to deliver personalised digital experiences and continuous platform improvements.

**What you’ll bring:**

* Proven experience developing solutions/forms using Sitecore XP/AI/XM.
* Strong knowledge of C\#, ASP.NET MVC, .NET Framework and/or .NET Core.
* Experience developing at the Sitecore component level on both the Microsoft stack and the NextJS stack.
* Experience developing RESTful APIs, system integrations and working with SQL Server.
* Experience using modern development pipeline practices including GitHub, Git actions, CI/CD, peer review and DevSecOps tooling.

**Why HCA UK?**


Originally founded over 50 years ago by Dr Thomas Frist, HCA has gone on to become one of the world’s leading healthcare providers. In the UK, we’re one of the largest providers of privately funded healthcare and have invested over £500 million in the latest treatments, technology, techniques, medication and facilities. Being part of a large multisite, established healthcare group we can offer you unrivalled opportunities for career progression through internal and external courses, as well as working conditions that prioritise both your mental and physical wellbeing.


By caring for our employees, we empower them to provide exceptional care for our patients. That's why we offer a host of flexible benefits that reflect the invaluable contribution they make every day. As a **Digital Developer** you'll be eligible for:


* 25 days holiday each year (plus bank holidays) increasing with service, with option to buy or sell leave to suit you
* Private Healthcare Insurance for treatment at our leading hospitals
* Private pension contribution which increases with length of service
* Season Ticket Loan and Cycle to Work scheme
* Group Life Assurance from day one
* Critical illness cover
* Enhanced Maternity and Paternity pay
* Corporate staff discount for all facilities including Maternity packages at The Portland
* Comprehensive range of flexible health, protection and lifestyle benefits to suit you
* Discounts with over 800 major retailers

**Culture and values**


At HCA UK we believe exceptional care starts with our people. We celebrate the unique perspectives and different experiences each of us bring as we know that when you feel seen, heard and supported you can be at your best for our patients, and each other.


Our mission is simple, above all else we’re committed to the care and improvement of human life, a clear statement that extends to both our patients and colleagues. To achieve this, we live and breathe four core values:


* **Unique and Individual:** We recognise and value everyone as unique and individual
* **Kindness and compassion:** We treat people with kindness and compassion
* **Honesty, integrity and fairness:** We act with absolute honesty, integrity and fairness
* **Loyalty, respect and dignity:** We trust and treat one another as valued members of the HCA UK family with loyalty, respect and dignity

**Reasonable adjustments**


We believe everyone should feel comfortable to bring their full self to work and be afforded the same opportunities. As a Disability Confident committed organisation, we’re happy to discuss flexible working arrangements to suit your needs as well as offer reasonable adjustments throughout our recruitment process, and in the workplace, to anyone that needs them.

jobs.title: Project Engineer
jobs.description:
**Project Engineer \- Engineering Projects**

  

Glasgow


£40,000


ORE Catapult \| Full Time \| Hybrid Working

 **About Us**

  

ORE Catapult is the UK's leading innovation centre for offshore renewable energy, accelerating the technologies needed to deliver a net zero future.

  

Working with industry, academia and government, we help develop, test and commercialise innovative technologies that support the growth of offshore wind, wave and tidal energy, whilst strengthening the UK supply chain and driving economic growth.

 **The Role**

  

We're looking for a **Project Engineer** to join our Research \& Engineering team.

  

This is an exciting opportunity for an engineer with a passion for innovation and technology development to support the delivery of cutting\-edge renewable energy projects across the offshore renewables sector.

  

As a Project Engineer, you'll lead the scoping, development and delivery of projects with ORE Catapult and external partners. You'll provide technical expertise across a range of engineering activities including mechanical design, analysis and simulation, technology development, and supply chain innovation support.

  

Working within our Engineering Projects team, you'll play a key role in delivering commercial, collaborative and research projects that help address some of the sector's most pressing engineering challenges. You'll work closely with industry partners, technology developers and stakeholders to develop innovative solutions that support the deployment and growth of offshore renewable energy technologies.

 **What You'll Be Doing**

  

* Leading the delivery of commercial and collaborative projects within ORE Catapult's Offshore Renewables portfolio.
* Providing technical leadership and subject matter expertise across engineering projects.
* Managing work delivered by engineers and external consultants to meet project objectives and quality standards.
* Supporting the development, scoping and initiation of new projects and opportunities.
* Working closely with internal teams, technology developers and supply chain partners to deliver project outcomes.
* Leading and contributing to industry workshops and stakeholder engagement activities.
* Producing high\-quality technical reports, analysis and project documentation.
* Supporting quality assurance, health and safety, environmental and quality management processes.
* Mentoring colleagues and supporting graduates, interns or apprentices as required.

 **About You**

  

You'll be an engineer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges and working in an innovation\-focused environment. You'll be comfortable managing multiple projects and collaborating with a wide range of stakeholders to deliver impactful engineering solutions.

  

You'll ideally have:

  

* A degree in a relevant engineering or scientific discipline such as Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Marine Engineering, Oil \& Gas Engineering or Naval Architecture.
* Around five years' relevant industry experience or demonstrable equivalent experience.
* Experience delivering technical engineering projects and activities successfully.
* Experience managing stakeholder relationships and engaging with industry partners.
* Knowledge of floating wind and the wider offshore wind industry.
* Experience using CAD, mechanical analysis and numerical modelling software.
* Strong problem\-solving, communication and organisational skills.
* The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
* A proactive, innovative and collaborative approach to engineering challenges.

 **Desirable**

  

* Knowledge of offshore renewable energy supply chains.
* Offshore field experience within offshore renewables or a related industry.

 **Why Join Us?**

  

This role offers the opportunity to work at the forefront of offshore renewable energy innovation, helping to develop technologies that support the UK's transition to net zero.

  

You'll work alongside leading engineers, researchers and industry partners on projects that make a tangible impact across the offshore renewable energy sector. From technology development and engineering analysis to supply chain innovation and industry collaboration, you'll help shape the future of renewable energy in the UK and beyond

 **Please note that this position is not eligible for Skilled Worker Visa Sponsorship. Applicants must have an existing right to work in the UK and be able to maintain that right for the full duration of their employment**.

Job Description
*Risk Solutions Tech Accelerate Graduate Program\-Software Engineer I*

*Are you a new or upcoming graduate seeking an entry\-level opportunity in the realm of Software Engineering?*

**Look no further than the prestigious Risk Solutions Tech Accelerate Graduate Program.**

**About the Business**

LexisNexis® Risk Solutions provides customers with solutions and decision tools that combine public and industry\-specific content with advanced technology and analytics to assist them in evaluating and predicting risk and enhancing operational efficiency. We use the power of data and advanced analytics to help our customers make better, timelier decisions. By bringing clarity to information, we ultimately help make communities safer, insurance rates more accurate, commerce more transparent, business decisions easier, and processes more efficient. You can learn more about LexisNexis Risk at the link below, https://risk.lexisnexis.com/


**About our Team**

LexisNexis Risk Solutions is a trusted data analytics provider, empowering organizations to manage risks, discover opportunities, and drive improved results. Our commitment to excellence and security enables well\-informed decisions. Our commitment to excellence is unwavering as we deliver targeted solutions that empower well\-informed decisions while upholding the highest standards of security and privacy. If you're eager to join a dynamic and innovative software development team, with a strong technology infrastructure, and contribute to products that truly make a difference, we invite you to apply for our 2026 Technology Graduate Program \- Entry Level Software Engineer role.


**About the Role**

The Risk Solutions Technology Graduate Program is a 12\-month experience with two six\-month rotations. Participants gain hands\-on experience in big data, AI, SRE, DevOps, and security engineering. They also get exposure to leading cloud platforms like AWS and Azure. The program focuses on technical and personal development, offering mentorship, performance feedback, and extensive training. Emphasis is placed on utilizing data for good, supporting key markets in insurance, healthcare, and government, and contributing to innovative product development.


**Responsibilities**

* Writing and reviewing portions of detailed specifications for developing system components of simple complexity.
* Implementing successful development processes, coding best practices, and code reviews under senior\-level engineers' guidance.
* Operating in various development environments and collaborating with key stakeholders.
* Completing simple bug fixes and applying knowledge of test\-driven development.
* Collaborating with stakeholders to gather and analyze requirements for software development projects.
* Resolving basic technical issues and staying updated on new technology developments.
* Demonstrating basic knowledge of software development methodologies and data manipulation languages.
* Understanding data modeling principles and applicable development languages.

  

**Requirements**

* Have completed or will complete a bachelor’s in Computer Science or a related field of study. **Applicants must have a graduation date between December 2026 and May 2027 to be considered.**
* Possess excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, to effectively collaborate with team members.
* Be proficient in development languages such as Java/J2EE, Spring Boot, Python, JavaScript, C\#, HTML, XML, SQL, Windows, Linux, and .Net.
* Be familiar with software development methodologies (e.g., Agile, Waterfall).
* Be knowledgeable about data manipulation languages and data modeling principles.
* Have the ability and desire to learn new processes and technologies.
* Be knowledgeable about test\-driven development.

Learn more about the LexisNexis Risk team and how we work here

jobs.title: Business Architect - Site Connectivity
jobs.description:
Employment Type: Full Time
Employment Period:
Salary: Circa £66,866 DoE
Location:
Felixstowe, GB, IP10 0DD Bristol, GB, BS32 4TP Leiston, GB, IP16 4EW London, GB, EC2R 7BP Manchester, GB, M1 4HN
Career Area: Data, Tech \& IT
**Business Architect \- Site Connectivity**
===========================================

Sizewell C’s business is to design, finance, construct, commission, operate, maintain, and eventually decommission the nuclear power plant and related infrastructure at Sizewell C in Suffolk. Overall, whilst the Company is in the construction phase, the Boards’ principal focus is on the development and construction of Sizewell C on time, on budget and to the highest quality and safety standards. The Company is maturing to meet all these requirements.

  

Sizewell C is economically regulated by OFGEM under the Regulated Asset Base (RAB) model similar to other UK electricity distribution networks and Thames Tideway.

  

Sizewell C construction strategy is to replicate the design of Hinkley Point C, using the majority of the same supply chain, but innovating in the way it is delivered to achieve savings in time and cost of around 20%. The CCO will need to be guided by and incorporate lessons learned from the Hinkley Point C commercial delivery to achieve Sizewell C’s ambition.

  

Following Financial Completion and Revenue Commencement, Sizewell C is fully funded and is owned by; The Secretary of State for Energy Security and Net Zero representing HM Government, La Caisse, Centrica, EDF and Amber Infrastructure.


Sizewell C is entering an exciting phase of growth as we mature into an independent organisation and continue building one of the UK’s largest and most important energy projects. We are now recruiting the below position.

  

**Business Architect \-** **Site Connectivity**

  

**Location:** Leiston (3 days per week) with travel to other sites.


**Contract**: Permanent, full\-time.

  

**Salary:** Circa £66,866 per annum, depending on experience.

  

**Benefits include:**


* Annual Leave: 28 days per annum, plus bank holidays.
* Bonus: 5% annual bonus.
* Defined Contribution Pension Scheme: with up to 7\.5% employee contribution 15% employer contribution.
  

**Closing Date: Wednesday 30th September 2026**

  

**Impact**

As Business Architect – Site Connectivity you will support the Business Architecture Lead in defining, coordinating and delivering business architecture activity for SZC site connectivity projects. This role focuses on the connectivity services required to mobilise and operate a large, live construction site, including new buildings, compounds and operational areas. The successful candidate will coordinate across Site Operations, Facilities Management, Construction delivery teams, Digital \& IT, network and telecommunications engineers, infrastructure and IT operations teams, internet and telephony service providers, contractors and suppliers to ensure requirements, constraints, dependencies and delivery commitments are understood and actively managed.

  

  

As Business Architect you will remain engaged through design, planning, procurement, physical hardware fit\-out, installation, operational transition and handover, managing evolving requirements, validating solutions and supporting readiness for business adoption.  



  

The role operates within SZC Digital \& IT governance structures and must ensure appropriate project, procurement, assurance, security, regulatory and approval requirements are completed. It requires regular presence on site and the confidence to work pragmatically in a live construction environment with evolving priorities and constraints.  



**Principal Accountabilities**


* Capture, evaluate, challenge and prioritise business requirements, maintaining traceability through design, procurement, installation and operational handover.
* Coordinate site connectivity initiatives across multiple construction and operational workstreams, ensuring requirements, dependencies, risks and delivery commitments are clearly understood and tracked.
* Act as the primary interface between Site Operations, Digital \& IT, suppliers and programme delivery teams for assigned projects.
* Support the mobilisation of connectivity services into new buildings, compounds and operational areas, from early requirements through to transition and handover.
* Engage with Facilities Management, Construction, Logistics, contractor and operational teams to understand site requirements, physical constraints, sequencing, access requirements and implementation impacts.
* Ensure appropriate governance, assurance, procurement and approval activities are completed in line with SZC delivery assurance principles.
* Support investment cases, project documentation, project mandates, governance submissions and programme reporting where required.
* Coordinate supplier and contractor activities, challenge plans constructively, and ensure actions, assumptions, dependencies and delivery commitments are understood and tracked to completion.
* Escalate blockers, delivery risks, conflicting priorities and unresolved dependencies proactively, with clear impacts and proposed options for resolution.
* Maintain stakeholder alignment across operational, technical and project teams, building effective relationships quickly across site and office\-based stakeholders.
* Support operational transition, business acceptance and handover activities for connectivity services, including walkthroughs, testing, readiness checks and lessons learned.
  

**Knowledge, Skills, Qualifications \& Experience**


* Strong understanding of business architecture change within complex, evolving and delivery\-critical environments.
* Strong business process analysis and design skills, including the ability to map operational requirements, constraints, dependencies and handover activities.
* Highly organised and proactive, with strong coordination, facilitation and follow\-through across multiple teams and workstreams.
* Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to build relationships quickly across operational, facilities, construction and technical teams.
* Confident challenging suppliers and contractors constructively, ensuring actions, risks and commitments are clear and progressed.
* Comfortable working on a live construction site and able to operate pragmatically in ambiguous, fast\-moving delivery environments.
* Able to analyse requirements, translate operational needs into clear delivery inputs and maintain alignment between business outcomes and technical delivery.
  

Desirable


* Broad knowledge of architecture standards, frameworks, and best practice methods.
* Strong analytical skills, able to apply a range of analysis techniques to complex problems.
  

**Qualifications \& Experience**


* Experience coordinating complex infrastructure, facilities, telecommunications, networking or connectivity projects.
* Experience with physical hardware fit design, planning, procurement and installation activities for infrastructure, networking, telecommunications or connectivity delivery.
* Experience working on large site mobilisation programmes, ideally in construction, infrastructure, asset\-intensive or operationally complex environments.
* Experience working alongside Facilities Management teams, Site Operations teams, Construction delivery teams, network and telecommunications engineers, infrastructure or IT operations teams, and internet and telephony service providers and contractors.
* Relevant qualifications and experience in one or more business architecture disciplines, including process management, business analysis, management information, infrastructure delivery support or IT system development.
* Experience supporting investment cases, supplier engagement, RFI or ITT activity, evaluation processes, project documentation and programme reporting.
* Familiarity with governance, assurance, cyber or nuclear security and regulatory considerations relevant to IT\-enabled change on a major programme.
  

Desirable


* Experience working in nuclear, major construction, asset\-intensive, safety\-critical or regulated infrastructure environments.
* Exposure to telecommunications, site networks, internet connectivity, telephony, temporary compounds, operational buildings or field\-based IT infrastructure delivery.
* Experience supporting operational transition, service readiness and handover from project delivery into business\-as\-usual support.
  

**Key Competencies**


* Integrates and aligns operational requirements, physical site constraints, processes, systems and supplier delivery plans across organisational boundaries.
* Fosters cross\-functional collaboration between site, facilities, construction, Digital \& IT, suppliers and project teams to identify practical solutions.
* Translates strategic and operational needs into actionable objectives, requirements, actions, controls and measures.
* Maintains delivery focus in ambiguous environments and drives actions through to completion.
* Builds trust and credibility with stakeholders by communicating clearly, following through on commitments and escalating issues early.
* Maintains commercial and operational awareness, considering wider site impacts, sequencing, supplier performance and value for money.
  

**Why Join Us?**

  

* Be part of one of the most important low\-carbon energy projects in the UK.
* Work in a mission\-driven environment that values innovation, integrity, and long\-term sustainability.
* Comprehensive benefits, and opportunities for career development.
* Flexible and hybrid working options.
  

**Behavioural Competences**

  

**Humility**

  

* Recognise the value brought from different cultures and experiences
* Be open to other’s points of view and ideas, be willing to debate and to compromise
  

**Positivity**

  

* Positively challenge poor quality and performance
* Identify solutions at the lowest possible level
* Encourage tier 1s and others to bring new ideas forward
  

**Respect**

  

* Value the rules and environment in which we operate
* Give and receive feedback with respect
* Embrace and engage with new people and ideas
  

**Solidarity**

  

* One team, working closely together and helping each other
* Empowered teams always looking forward.
* Shared responsibility for delivery the project outcomes
  

**Clarity**

  

* Communicate clearly and consistently
* Promote collaboration and team alignment
* Clearer and faster decision making

**Business Architect \- Digital Construction**
==============================================

Sizewell C’s business is to design, finance, construct, commission, operate, maintain, and eventually decommission the nuclear power plant and related infrastructure at Sizewell C in Suffolk. Overall, whilst the Company is in the construction phase, the Boards’ principal focus is on the development and construction of Sizewell C on time, on budget and to the highest quality and safety standards. The Company is maturing to meet all these requirements.

  

Sizewell C is economically regulated by OFGEM under the Regulated Asset Base (RAB) model similar to other UK electricity distribution networks and Thames Tideway.

  

Sizewell C construction strategy is to replicate the design of Hinkley Point C, using the majority of the same supply chain, but innovating in the way it is delivered to achieve savings in time and cost of around 20%. The CCO will need to be guided by and incorporate lessons learned from the Hinkley Point C commercial delivery to achieve Sizewell C’s ambition.

  

Following Financial Completion and Revenue Commencement, Sizewell C is fully funded and is owned by; The Secretary of State for Energy Security and Net Zero representing HM Government, La Caisse, Centrica, EDF and Amber Infrastructure.


Sizewell C is entering an exciting phase of growth as we mature into an independent organisation and continue building one of the UK’s largest and most important energy projects. We are now recruiting the below position.

  

**Business Architect – Digital Construction**

  

**Location:** Leiston (3 days per week) with travel to other sites.


**Contract**: Permanent, full\-time.

  

**Salary:** Circa £66,866 per annum, depending on experience.

  

**Benefits include:**


* Annual Leave: 28 days per annum, plus bank holidays.
* Bonus: 5% annual bonus.
* Defined Contribution Pension Scheme: with up to 7\.5% employee contribution 15% employer contribution.
  

**Closing Date: Wednesday 30th September 2026**

  

**Impact**

The SZC Digital \& IT directorate sits within the PMO Unit which in turn sits within the overall delivery department. Digital \& IT is accountable for providing Enterprise IT infrastructure and application to the business and to a subset of Tier 1 contract partners.


The Architecture function is one of four functions reporting into the Digital Director and delivers the architectural strategy and roadmap for SZC.


As Business Architect you will support the Business Architecture Lead in defining, planning, and delivering Business Architecture projects for the Sizewell C (SZC) Digital \& IT team. You will work closely with senior stakeholders and project teams to design effective and efficient business operating models, ensuring that proposed changes are strategically aligned and deliver measurable benefits.

  

  

As Business Architect you will remain engaged through development and implementation phases, managing evolving requirements, validating solutions, and supporting readiness for business adoption.  



**Framework \& Boundaries**

As Business Architect you will receive delivery objectives from the Business Architecture Lead and may work independently or as part of a multi\-disciplinary team. While you may specialise in process, IT, or management information, you maybe expected to maintain a broad understanding of all Business Architecture disciplines to identify interdependencies and ensure integrated solutions. They will lead early\-stage project definition, develop project mandates, and prepare investment cases, working with suppliers and internal teams to identify best\-fit solutions.


The role operates within the SZC Digital \& IT governance structures, aligning with project management, procurement, and regulatory requirements, and must ensure solutions comply with industry standards and SZC licence obligations.

  

**Principal Accountabilities**


* **Lead engagements** with business stakeholders to define project concepts, clarify scope, assess impacts, and identify initial risks, issues, and dependencies.
* Capture, evaluate, challenge, and **prioritise business requirements** in consultation with senior management, ensuring alignment with business strategy.
* **Collaborate with internal teams and external delivery partners** to develop solution options and evaluate these against business and user needs.
* Prepare robust **business cases and investment proposals**, articulating clear, tangible benefits and identifying opportunities for maximising value.
* **Act as the custodian of business requirements** throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring solutions remain aligned with agreed outcomes.
* Apply knowledge of emerging trends, best practice, and innovative solutions to drive **continuous improvement in business operations**.
* Support **business acceptance** of new processes and systems, including walkthroughs, testing, and readiness activities.
* Ensure all projects adhere to SZC and EDFE delivery assurance principles and governance standards.
  

**Dimensions**


The Business Architect report to the Business Architecture Lead, and will work alongside a network of 12 Business Architects within SZC Digital \& IT. The role holder will be aligned to specific SZC delivery functions (e.g., Engineering, Construction, Project Delivery, Business Services), and will be responsible for developing and maintaining relationships with senior stakeholders, external partners, and suppliers.

  

**Knowledge, Skills, Qualifications \& Experience**


* Strong understanding of **business architecture change** within complex, evolving environments.
* Expertise in **business process analysis** **and design**, including use of modelling and collaboration tools.
* Advanced **stakeholder management** and facilitation skills, with the ability to influence at senior levels.
  

Desirable


* Broad knowledge of architecture standards, frameworks, and best practice methods.
* Strong analytical skills, able to apply a range of analysis techniques to complex problems.
  

**Qualifications \& Experience**


* Relevant qualifications and experience in one or more **business architecture disciplines**: process management, business analysis, management information, or IT system development.
* Experience **delivering business architecture solutions** that remove duplication and improve operational efficiency.
* Familiarity with **ONR licence conditions and cyber/nuclear security requirements** relevant to IT\-enabled change.
* Experience of formal **project management** approaches (e.g., PRINCE2, EDF Project Way) and tools.
* Experience of **procurement activities** (RFI, ITT) and evaluation processes.
* Proven experience in **developing investment cases** for large, complex programmes.
  

Desirable


* Experience working in nuclear, asset\-intensive, or safety\-critical industries.
* Exposure to business change programmes in major infrastructure projects.
  

**Key Competencies**


* Ability to integrate and align processes and systems across organisational boundaries.
* Fosters cross\-functional collaboration to identify optimal solutions.
* Translates strategy into actionable objectives and measures.
* Encourages continuous improvement and constructive challenge to the status quo.
* Builds trust and credibility with stakeholders by delivering on commitments.
* Maintains commercial awareness and considers wider impacts of decisions.
  

**Why Join Us?**

  

* Be part of one of the most important low\-carbon energy projects in the UK.
* Work in a mission\-driven environment that values innovation, integrity, and long\-term sustainability.
* Comprehensive benefits, and opportunities for career development.
* Flexible and hybrid working options.
  

**Behavioural Competences**

* Recognise the value brought from different cultures and experiences
* Be open to other’s points of view and ideas, be willing to debate and to compromise
  

**Positivity**

jobs.title: Substation Project Engineer
jobs.description:
**Base Location:** For this role, we require successful applicants to be based from one of our Scottish locations and you'll be expected to spend 50% of your working week in the office – Glasgow, Perth, Inverness or Aberdeen


**Salary:** £51,600 \- £77,400\+ car /car allowance \+ performance\-related bonus \+ a range of benefits to support your finances, wellbeing and family.


**Working Pattern:** Permanent \| Full Time \| Flexible First options available


**The role**



As part of SSEN Transmissions Offshore Portfolio of works, we have an opportunity for a Substation Project Engineer to join our Offshore AC Project Engineering team to help drive forward our Island projects and successfully deliver a network for Net Zero. Our Island projects facilitate the connection to our HVDC systems and include state\-of the\-art AC plant, grid control and stabilisation technology.


**You will**


* Create outline scope, site location plans, primary plant/ substation layout and Single Line Diagrams for new build and asset replacement type projects, operating up to 400kV.


* Review contractor/consultants detailed designs and witness Factory Acceptance Tests.


* Implement safety by design principles to ensure that engineering and safety risks are adequately controlled.


* Support site and operational teams to ensure the quality of installations, with minimal risk to Network security.


* Evaluate tenders and procure and manage specialist services from consultants.


**You have**


* Experience in transmission level substation projects, document review, factory acceptance testing, installation and commissioning ideally up to 400kV including AIS and GIS, and be comfortable to technically assess issues and critically assess a range of technical solutions.


* An understanding of the legislation and implications for the Transmission network management for both Assets and Projects, including Construction Design Management \& Electricity Safety, Quality and Continuity Regulations.


* A problem solving attitude with the strength of character to ensure critical matters are addressed by the project teams.


* Enthusiasm combined with excellent communication skills, with the ability to demonstrate diligence and prioritise tasks.


* A degree or HND in Electrical Engineering or relevant technical experience and ideally be a Chartered Engineer or working towards professional accreditation with a relevant institution.


**About SSE**



SSE’s purpose is to be restless every day until we make electricity clean, affordable and available for all.



We do this by developing, building, operating and investing in electricity infrastructure and businesses needed in the energy transition. This includes electricity transmission and distribution networks, onshore and offshore wind farms, hydro\-electric power and flexible thermal generation. We also provide products and services for businesses and other customers.



Our investment plan will see SSE invest £33bn in critical electricity infrastructure to 2030\.



SSEN Transmission own and operate the electricity transmission network across the north of Scotland. We transport electricity from where it is generated to where it is needed, ensuring a safe and reliable electricity supply for the communities we serve. But that's not all – we're upgrading the grid to deliver cleaner, homegrown power for the future and building the infrastructure needed for a cleaner electricity system to create secure power for generations to come.


**Flexible benefits to fit your life**



Enjoy discounts on private healthcare and gym memberships. Wellbeing benefits like a free online GP and 24/7 counselling service. Interest\-free loans on tech and transport season tickets, or a new bike with our Cycle to Work scheme. As well as generous family entitlements such as maternity and adoption pay, and paternity leave.


**Work with an equal opportunity employer**



SSE will make any reasonable adjustments you need to ensure that your application and experience with us is positive. Please contact Hannah.E.Cutajar@sse.com / \+44 (0\) 1738 341147 to discuss how we can support you.



We're dedicated to fostering an open and inclusive workplace where people from all backgrounds can thrive. We create equal opportunities for everyone to succeed and especially welcome applications from those who may not be well represented in our workforce or industry.


**Ready to apply?**



Start your online application using the Apply Now box on this page. We only accept applications made online. We'll be in touch after the closing date to let you know if we'll be taking your application further. If you're offered a role with SSE, you'll need to complete a criminality check and a credit check before you start work.

jobs.title: Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:
West Malling, Kent
  
As an **IT Infrastructure Engineer** at Cabot Credit Management, you will play a key role in delivering and supporting robust, secure, and scalable technology services across our organisation. With a primary focus on UK operations and an awareness of wider European business needs, you’ll take a hands\-on approach to infrastructure support, system administration, and project delivery.


Operating within our IT Operations team, you’ll provide expert 3rd line support and technical leadership across a diverse technology landscape \- proactively troubleshooting, optimising systems, and collaborating with stakeholders to ensure our IT services remain reliable, resilient, and fit for the future.


**What you can expect as an Infrastructure Engineer:**


* Permanent
* Hybrid role from our Kings Hill office, Kent. ME19 4UA.

Not only are we offering a competitive salary and a fantastic bonus scheme, you’ll also be entitled to loads of great benefits including, discount and cash back on hundreds of high\-street shops and private health insurance, plus much more.


**Key responsibilities include:**


* Ensure high availability, reliability, and security are embedded across infrastructure and service delivery.
* Lead vulnerability management, patching, and preventative maintenance across platforms.
* Provide technical leadership and 3rd line support, resolving complex and high\-impact incidents.
* Review, validate, and contribute to infrastructure design and project delivery.
* Support IT governance, compliance, and audits (including SOX, PCI\-DSS), ensuring adherence to controls and regulations.
* Operate within ITIL frameworks, managing incidents, problems, and changes effectively.
* Plan and execute disaster recovery testing to ensure business continuity.
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimise systems to maintain performance and integrity.
* Collaborate with internal teams, external partners, and vendors to deliver and support services.
* Integrate security and best practice into all technology and lifecycle decisions.
* Support ongoing system administration, service improvements, and out\-of\-hours escalation where required.

**We are looking for someone with:**

**Essential:**


* Expert level NetApp Ontap and AFF skills
* Strong expertise in Windows Server platforms.
* Experience with VMware and Microsoft AVD
* Microsoft Exchange (2016/2019 Hybrid), Office 365, and PowerShell scripting.
* Dell Server Hardware knowledge
* Veeam Backup and Replication
* Web technologies (IIS, .NET).
* Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DFS, DHCP, WINS.
* Windows/SQL clustering.
* Strong documentation and communication skills.
* Understanding of ITIL processes and service management.

**Desirable:**


* Azure administration (servers, storage, networking).
* Office 365 support (Exchange, Teams, SharePoint).
* Intune device management.
* Security tools (CrowdStrike, Rapid7\).
* Experience in financial services environments.
* Monitoring tools (e.g., PRTG).
* Azure Entra administration.
* Ivanti patching and deployment.
* Certifications (Preferred):
* MCSE, VCP, VMCE, NCDA

**What happens next?**

If this sounds like you and you’d like to join our rapidly expanding company that offers excellent career progression, then apply now!


**Working for Cabot:**


You’ll be working for an award winning; Investors in People Gold accredited organisation. We’re passionate about the ethical treatment of our customers and employees. Our mission is to create pathways to economic freedom. Our vision is to make credit accessible by partnering with our consumers to restore their financial health.


**Diversity and inclusion** are very important to us at Cabot, and we value a multitude of diverse talent within our business. We want everyone to be themselves at work and encourage a culture that includes everyone. Our policies ensure that every candidate and employee are treated fairly and with equal opportunities.


*\*\*At Cabot we are highly regulated by our clients, as such, any successful candidates will have to undergo a basic credit check and criminal background check. Please note that we are unable to proceed to interview stage if a CCJ, IVA or Bankruptcy appears on a credit file, or if you do not have full right to work in the UK – we are unfortunately unable to offer sponsorship.*


  
**We are people helping people**
--------------------------------


At Cabot, we’re people helping people. Supporting customers, empowering colleagues, and making the effort to be invovled in the communities we work in.


**Our Total Rewards Package for All Round Wellbeing**
-----------------------------------------------------


We understand the importance of the balance between work and life, between fun and professionalism, and between being a corporation and being a community. That’s why we provide compensation structures and benefit plans tailored to each of our global hubs, and then enhance them with a wide range of programs that support your personal and professional growth. It’s our way of showing you that we recognize your value, understand what’s important to you, and want to reward your contributions.


* ### **Holistic Wellness**
