jobs.title: Junior Software Developer
jobs.description:
Build technology that makes road inspections faster, safer and smarter. Grow your development skills in a small product team, with guidance from experienced colleagues.

**About SmartVision**

SmartVision is reimagining highway inspections with AI. Our platform brings together computer\-vision analysis, geospatial mapping and inspection management, turning road images into practical intelligence that helps teams understand road condition, prioritise maintenance and confirm repairs.

We are building SmartVision as a focused, growing company with a small team and an ambitious product. That means less distance between an idea and its impact — and plenty of scope for the right developer to help shape how we work and what we build next.

**The opportunity**

We’re looking for a curious and motivated Junior Software Developer who is ready to build their skills by solving real product problems. Working alongside experienced colleagues, you’ll help design, build and improve applications across our .NET, SQL and React stack, while also gaining experience with Python and Azure\-hosted components.

This role will suit someone who enjoys learning, asks thoughtful questions and is comfortable in a startup\-style environment where priorities can evolve. You’ll receive guidance and support, while being encouraged to contribute ideas, take increasing responsibility and become a well\-rounded developer as SmartVision grows.

**What you’ll do**

* Help design and develop robust, maintainable applications using .NET, SQL and React.
* Learn how to turn product and customer needs into well\-considered technical solutions.
* Contribute to Azure\-hosted components using Python, object storage and event queues.
* Work with product, test and development colleagues to deliver valuable features.
* Maintain and improve existing applications through updates, refactoring and enhancements.
* Learn to estimate work, communicate progress and raise questions or risks early.
* Test your work thoroughly and build your understanding of reliability, security and performance.
* Investigate and resolve issues with support from the wider team.
* Contribute ideas in team and project discussions and learn from code reviews and feedback.
* Develop your technical knowledge and share what you learn with colleagues.

**What we’re looking for**

* A foundation in C\#/.NET and SQL, gained through study, a bootcamp, personal projects, a placement, an internship or your first development role.
* Some experience with React, or a comparable modern framework such as Angular or Vue.
* Awareness of Microsoft Azure, Python, object storage and event queues, together with an interest in developing your practical experience with these technologies.
* A basic understanding of Git and version\-control workflows.
* An understanding of testing, debugging and the importance of clear, maintainable code.
* Clear communication, attention to detail and a willingness to ask questions and act on feedback.
* Comfort working collaboratively in a small team and adapting as priorities change.
* Curiosity about the product, its users and the real\-world problems the technology is solving.

**Useful, but not essential**

* Commercial experience gained through an internship, placement or first software\-development role.
* Experience with geospatial applications, mapping or Geographic Information Systems (GIS).
* Experience building event\-driven, data\-rich, image\-based or AI\-enabled applications.
* Experience with Visual Studio or the wider Microsoft development ecosystem.

**What you’ll get**

* Visible impact: work on a product that turns complex road data into decisions people can act on.
* Supported development: learn from experienced colleagues through guidance, feedback and code reviews.
* Growing responsibility: take on broader and more complex work as your confidence develops.
* A close\-knit team: collaborate directly with the people shaping and delivering the product.
* Room to grow: develop with the company as SmartVision establishes itself and expands.
* Company benefits such as 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays and a day off for your birthday, and the Bike2Work Scheme.

**How to apply**

Apply through Tech Talent Champions via https://techtalentchampions.com/opportunities using the form on the page.

Include your CV and a short note explaining why SmartVision interests you.

Pay: £26,000\.00\-£32,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Dual Fuel Smart Meter Engineer
jobs.description:
Dual Fuel Smart Meter Engineer**Locations: CT, ME**


Are you a qualified Dual Fuel Smart Meter Engineer looking for excellent earning potential, structured work and the security of working directly for an established energy supplier?


At Utilita, we're growing our award\-winning Field Services team. Join one of the UK's fastest\-growing energy suppliers and a business that has been recognised as one of the UK's Top 50 Best Workplaces for four consecutive years.


What is in it for you?


You'll receive a base salary of £38,993, alongside uncapped earning potential and a variety of opportunities to boost your overall earnings, including:


* **On\-call payment:** Receive £330 for each on\-call week, based on an average rota of one week in five. (OTE of £42,293 just with the base salary and conducting mandatory on call requirements)
* **Industry\-leading installation bonus:** Benefit from an uncapped installation bonus of £25 per meter or £50 per dual installation once you have completed a minimum of four installations in a day, with additional work opportunities available to further enhance your earnings.
* **London weighting:** Receive an additional £2,000 annual allowance if you live within the M25\.
* **Enhanced overtime:** Enhanced overtime rates for Sunday working.

Alongside your salary and uncapped earning potential, you will receive 25 days’ annual leave plus bank holidays, a healthcare scheme, mental wellbeing support, access to 24/7 GP and counselling services, and a generous pension scheme. You will also receive one paid volunteering day each year and have opportunities to win tickets to events at Utilita\-sponsored arenas and football matches.


Why work at Utilita?

**A schedule that supports your work\-life balance.**


We understand that a great Smart Meter Engineer role is not just about salary. It is also about having a structured working day and being able to plan your life accordingly.


You will be scheduled an average of 4 jobs per day, with an average travel time to jobs of approximately 35 minutes between appointments.


We aim to schedule your work several weeks in advance, giving you greater visibility of your schedule. This helps you plan life outside work while still giving you the opportunity to take on additional work when it suits you.

**First\-class training and support.**


Your journey will begin at our award\-winning training academy in Warrington, where you will receive a comprehensive induction.


You will then receive ongoing mentoring to help you strengthen your knowledge, understand our processes and confidently adapt to the Utilita way of working.

**A team that keeps you connected.**


We understand that working in the field can sometimes feel isolating, which is why creating a connected and supportive environment is so important to us.


Through regular manager check\-ins, access to technical experts, collaborative colleague networks and ongoing communication, you'll always have the support you need and someone to turn to throughout your working day.


What you will be doing.


As a Dual Fuel Smart Meter Engineer, you will represent Utilita in customers’ homes, installing smart meters safely and professionally across domestic properties.


You will play an important role in delivering our customer\-first approach, providing a positive experience while maintaining high standards of safety, quality and service.

**What we need from you.**


To be considered for this opportunity, you will need:

* Smart Metering qualifications, including CCN1 or CMA1 and MET1, or equivalent.
* At least 12 months experience working as a Dual Fuel Smart Meter Engineer.
* A valid full UK driving licence.


Who are Utilita?


Founded in 2003, Utilita Energy was created to challenge the Big Six energy suppliers by offering a fair and flexible service that is good for both the pocket and the planet.


As the first supplier to install a Smart Meter back in 2005 and kick\-start Britain’s smart meter revolution, we continue to invest in smart technology and look for new ways to improve our services through innovation.


We are also committed to sustainability, with an ambition to become a Net Zero business by 2030\. We believe everyone can make a meaningful impact through small, positive changes.


Our values are simple but powerful:

**Fairness. Smart. Sustainability.**


Our employees and customers come from all walks of life. We are committed to championing diversity, creating an inclusive culture and providing an environment where you can be your authentic self.


Utilita is part of the Luxion group whichcomprises Luxion Group Ltd, Utilita Energy Ltd, Luxion Sales Ltd, Utilita Field Services Ltd, Procode Technology Ltd and Canary Care Global Ltd.

jobs.title: Assistant Civil Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Title :** Assistant Civil Engineer

**Location:** Port of Tilbury

**Salary:** £45,000 \- £48,000

**About Forth Ports**


Forth Ports is one of the UK's largest and most dynamic port operator groups, playing a key role in connecting the UK with Europe and beyond. As a multimodal ports owner and operator, we are at the forefront of delivering innovative port\-related services.


With our recent pledge to achieve carbon neutrality by 2032 and Net Zero status by 2042, we are committed to sustainability and driving the expansion of the UK's renewable energy sector, particularly offshore wind. Now is an exciting time to join our team as we embark on this transformative journey towards a greener future.

**About The Role**

**ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS \- Please ensure you meet these before applying:**

* Unrestricted right to work in the UK (we do not offer visa sponsorship)
* Civil Engineering degree (BEng/MEng) or equivalent
* 2\-3 years post graduate UK construction/civil engineering experience
* Full UK driving licence

**About the Role**


This is an exceptional opportunity for an ambitious civil engineer technician at the beginning of your career to accelerate your skills within a complex, operational port environment. You'll work on diverse infrastructure projects ranging from quayside structures and pavements to drainage systems and utilities \- all within a live, 24/7 operational setting that presents unique engineering challenges.


As a Civil Engineering Technician, you'll take genuine ownership of projects from inception through to completion, supported by our experienced Engineering leadership team. This isn't a graduate training scheme \- you'll be managing real projects with budgets, programmes, and contractor interfaces from day one.

**Typical projects include:**

* Quayside and marine structure repairs and upgrades
* Internal road and pavement reconstruction \& repair programmes
* Drainage and utilities infrastructure works
* Structural inspections and remedial works
* Port estate development projects supporting operational growth

**This role requires regular site presence across the Port of Tilbury estate. Due to the operational nature of the port environment, regular remote working is not available. You must be within commutable distance of Tilbury.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Project Delivery**

* Take ownership of civil engineering projects from feasibility through to practical completion
* Manage project programmes, budgets (typically £50k \- £500k)
* Coordinate with operational teams to schedule works around 24/7 port activities

**Technical Responsibilities**

* Produce and update technical drawings using AutoCAD
* Develop scopes of works and review contractor designs and method statements
* Apply engineering principles to solve practical problems in a live operational environment

**CDM and Safety Compliance**

* Act as Client representative under CDM 2015 regulations
* Ensure contractors comply with port safety requirements and permit\-to\-work systems

**What We're Looking For**

**Essential Experience and Qualifications:**

* BEng or MEng in Civil Engineering(or closely related discipline)
* 2\-3 years UK construction or civil engineering project experience working with contractors on site
* AutoCAD proficiency\- able to produce and modify civil engineering drawings
* Full UK driving licence \- site travel is a daily requirement

**Essential Skills:**

* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously with competing priorities
* Practical problem\-solving approach \- able to make decisions on site
* Comfortable working independently whilst knowing when to escalate

**What Forth Ports Can Offer You**


At Forth Ports, our people are our priority, and we are committed to creating a flexible, open, and supportive working culture. As part of our team, you will enjoy:

* 26 days annual leave plus bank holidays
* Defined pension scheme and life assurance
* Professional membership subscriptions paid (ICE, IStructE, etc.)
* Health promotion events and employee wellbeing initiatives
* Access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) for you and your family
* Cycle to work scheme
* Attractive family\-friendly policies
* Employee discount platform offering discounts on UK\-wide restaurants, car rentals, and holidays
* GymFlex health club memberships


We value diversity and inclusivity, and we are an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability status.

We are proud to support the Armed Forces Covenant and recognise the value serving personnel, veterans, reservists, and military families bring to our organisation.


As a signatory to the Armed Forces Covenant, we are committed to ensuring that members of the Armed Forces community are treated fairly and are not disadvantaged in their civilian careers because of their service.


We welcome applications from veterans, reservists, cadet force adult volunteers, and military spouses/partners, and we actively support flexible and inclusive recruitment practices.

 **How to Apply**


If you're a motivated civil engineer with 2\-3 years UK experience looking to develop your career in the port and infrastructure sector, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your CV highlighting relevant UK project experience

**Apply via the 'Apply Now' link.**

*Applications from candidates without UK work authorisation or relevant UK experience will not be progressed.*

**Required Criteria**

* Civil Engineering degree (BEng/MEng) or equivalent
* 2\-3 years post graduate UK construction/civil engineering experience
* Full UK driving licence

 **About The Company**


Over our 50 years of experience we have witnessed our ports grow to become important assets to support and deliver growth both for the UK and local economies.


The growth impact has been achieved due to the continued investments in our infrastructure, making sure that our ports are able to continually develop their services and support the growth of many industries.


Our people have played a significant role. They have delivered the highest quality of service through their expertise, loyalty and flexibility and, without them, we could not have built the strong reputation and the long term agreements with many customers that we have today.

**Company Culture**


Welcome to Forth Ports Careers. As a leading port operator, we employ over 1,100 people across our ports in Scotland and the Port of Tilbury in London.

The Port of Tilbury Grain Terminal is the UK’s largest grain handling facility for both imports and exports, operating to food\-grade standards through a state\-of\-the\-art, fully automated and highly flexible terminal. As an Engineering Technician, you will play a vital role in carrying out planned and reactive maintenance across plant, equipment and engineering systems, responding promptly to faults and breakdowns and helping ensure the Grain Terminal continues to operate safely, efficiently and reliably.

* Carry out installations, improvements and modifications to new and existing plant, systems and equipment.
* Promptly report any damage, misuse or operational concerns relating to plant and equipment to Engineering or Operational Managers.

* Communicate clearly with team members, Supervisors and Managers to provide updates on plant status, repairs and breakdown activity.
* Prepare engineering reports and complete required documentation, including statutory check records where appropriate.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**IONETIC – who are we?**



IONETIC is a battery technology start\-up based in Brackley, just a few miles from Silverstone—the heart of British motorsport. We specialise in battery pack solutions for low\-volume electrified applications, including buses, sports cars, and other vehicles. Our mission is to make electrification both possible and compelling for every vehicle OEM, by providing tailored, cost\-effective battery packs with unmatched speed and flexibility.



By integrating proprietary software, mechanical design, and manufacturing technologies into a single technology stack we call Arc, we deliver custom battery systems that meet a wide range of energy, power, and lifecycle requirements. Our chemistry\-agnostic, scalable designs are built to accelerate the journey to net zero for our customers.

 **Working at IONETIC**



IONETIC offers an exciting opportunity to be part of a fast\-moving, innovative start\-up that is shaping the future of electric mobility. With a strong order pipeline and growing demand for our technology, we're expanding our team to broaden our capabilities and scale our operations.



As an early\-stage employee, you will play a key role in developing the foundational technologies and capabilities that will power the next generation of electric vehicles. Every employee at IONETIC takes on meaningful responsibility and is encouraged to contribute ideas, take initiative, and grow both professionally and personally in a supportive, collaborative environment.

 **Opportunity**



We are looking for a Software Engineer to build, deploy, and maintain IONETIC's internal software toolchain. In this role, you will design and develop software that supports engineering activities across the business, working closely with the engineering team to turn technical requirements into working software.



You will work across the stack as needed, contributing to tooling, deployment, and data management practices that keep the toolchain reliable and scalable.

 **Responsibilities**


* Design and build software across IONETIC's internal toolchain
* Deploy and maintain software and supporting infrastructure
* Manage and structure data used across the toolchain
* Write clean, maintainable, well\-documented code
* Work across the stack as needed, including tooling in Python, TypeScript, and C\#
* Collaborate with engineers to translate technical requirements into working software
* Contribute to decisions on software architecture and design

  


**Skills and Experience**


* Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related discipline, or equivalent experience
* Solid Python skills, with exposure to TypeScript and/or C\# a plus
* Understanding of software architecture and design principles
* Experience deploying and maintaining software in production
* Awareness of data management practices, including structure, storage, and integrity
* Experience working on non\-trivial software projects, ideally in a team setting
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Overview**  

In Microsoft Frontier Company, you won’t just build software; you’ll deliver real outcomes for some of the world’s most complex organizations.

  

We are a global team of world\-class engineers who have been working in a Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) model for more than a decade, embedding directly within customer teams to solve their toughest challenges, side\-by\-side, and shipping production\-ready solutions in days, not months.

  

As a Principal Software Engineer, you will bring strong software design and engineering expertise, building reliable systems and production\-ready services that turn ideas and data\-driven insights into scalable solutions. You’ll work in small, multidisciplinary crews alongside data scientists, product managers, and domain experts, owning the full lifecycle from design through to deployed solutions.

  

Our work is powered by AI, applying the mindset and tooling across the entire development lifecycle to move from idea to production in days while maintaining the highest standards of security, quality, and trust.

  

This role offers the opportunity to:

* **Build reliable, production\-ready systems and services that turn ideas into scalable solutions**
* **Ship engineering work that directly influences business strategy and customer outcomes**
* **Collaborate with leading global organizations across industries**
* **Apply the latest advancements in AI and software engineering to solve problems at scale**

  

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**  

* **Put security first:** Build and ship solutions that meet enterprise security standards (threat modeling, secure coding, privacy, and compliance) from design through production.
* **Translate business needs into technical solutions:** Partner with stakeholders to define problem statements, success metrics, and architectural approaches that deliver measurable outcomes.
* **Design and lead architecture:** Own end\-to\-end system design for cloud and AI workloads, making sound tradeoffs across reliability, performance, cost, and maintainability.
* **Deliver quickly without sacrificing quality:** Use modern engineering practices (CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and progressive delivery) to iterate fast and reduce operational risk.

jobs.title: Security Engineer, AWS Security
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the leading cloud provider, providing virtualised infrastructure, storage, networking, messaging, and many other services to customers all over the world. AWS runs a globally distributed environment, operating at massive levels of scale. Businesses, from start\-ups to enterprises, run their operations and applications on AWS’ multi\-tenant infrastructure.  

  

As a Security Engineer, you’ll help to build and manage services that detect and automate the mitigation of cybersecurity threats across Amazon’s infrastructure. You’ll work with data scientists, software development engineers, and other security engineers across multiple teams to develop innovative, world\-leading security solutions. Our services protect the AWS cloud for all customers and preserves our customers’ trust in us. You’ll get to use the full power and breadth of AWS technologies to build services that proactively protect AWS customers, both internally and externally, from security threats.  

  

You will be working in a team of industry\-leading security experts working with UK customers to operate and continuously improve industry\-leading security programs and processes. This role forms part of our Security Operations Centre (SOC) and you will be responsible for building detections and responding to security incidents. Aside from security incident management, you will be expected to think strategically and build innovative solutions to improve efficiency across the team. As large part of this will be introducing AI and automation.  

  

This is a truly unique opportunity to support and improve the security of a world leading cloud provider, working at the forefront of innovation and alongside world class industry experts.  

  

About Amazon Security  

  

Diverse Experiences  

Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why Amazon Security?  

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organisation is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fuelled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  

  

Training \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, training, and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Work as part of a Security Operations Centre (SOC).
* Build detections to identify suspicious and malicious behaviour.
* Engineer innovate solutions and automation to improve processes.

  

About the team  

The team consists of a mix of security engineers, ranging in experience from junior to experienced.
  

  

You will need to be a UK national and able to obtain and maintain a UK Government Security Clearance. Further details found here: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united\-kingdom\-security\-vetting\-clearance\-levels  

  

This team works alongside the wider security team, including insider risk, information security, assurance and physical security.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* Knowledge of networking protocols such as HTTP, DNS and TCP/IP
* Experience programming in Python, Ruby, Go, Swift, Java, .Net, C\+\+ or similar object oriented language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with AWS products and services
* Experience with any combination of the following: threat modeling, secure coding, identity management and authentication, software development, cryptography, system administration and network security
* Experience with programming languages such as Python, Java, C\+\+

  

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.  

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.title: Structural Engineer for calculations (for projects in Sweden)
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

AFRY provides engineering, design, digital and advisory services to accelerate the transition towards a sustainable society.


AFRY employs over 18,000 professionals in more than 50 countries. Net sales in 2024 were SEK 27,160 million.


AFRY is organized into three Divisions: Energy; Industry and Transportation \& Places.


The Global Division Transportation \& Places is active within transportation infrastructure, real estate, water and environment in the Nordics and Central Europe. The division has about 6,500 employees and is structured around two segments: Road \& Rail and Public \& Commercial Places.

 **Job Description**  

In Sweden we currently have 80 Structural building engineers working within Public and Commercial places. We work with a wide scope of assignments ranging from the planning\-stage to execution of drawings for final production. In general we work in 10\-15 persons teams assigned to different projects, our engineers have a typical workload of 2\-4 ongoing projects.


Typical projects are within the segments airports, hospitals, offices, schools, public transportation, high security facilities, defense, retail and residential.

**Our Service Areas\-you will become part of one of the described Teams:**


Region East \- Structural Engineering


Region East consists of approximately 35 structural engineers located across Stockholm, Norrköping, Linköping and Motala. The organization is characterized by a strong senior profile, with the majority of its engineers having 10\-35 years of experience in structural engineering and building design.


The region delivers structural engineering services across a broad range of sectors, including healthcare facilities, schools, airports, sports facilities, defense, residential developments, office buildings, energy facilities, and transportation/infrastructure projects. Clients are primarily public sector organizations, such as municipalities, regional authorities, government agencies, and public property owners, complemented by collaborations with contractors and private developers.


With offices strategically located in both the Stockholm area and Östergötland, Region East combines extensive technical expertise with strong local presence and the capacity to manage complex multidisciplinary projects throughout Sweden. The region is led by Joakim Tornberg (Market area manager), Daniel Warminski (SAM Stockholm South), Victor Prevé (SAM Stockholm North), and Peter Svensson (SAM Östergötland).


Region West \- Structural Engineering


Region West consists of approximately 30 structural engineers based in Göteborg, Skövde and Alingsås. The organization is characterized by a strong senior profile, with the majority of its engineers having 10\-30 years of experience in structural engineering and building design.


The region delivers structural engineering services across a broad range of sectors, including healthcare facilities, schools, residential developments, defense projects, and energy\-related facilities. Clients primarily comprise public sector organizations, such as municipalities and regional authorities, as well as major construction companies and contractors.


With offices strategically located across western Sweden, Region West combines extensive technical expertise with strong local presence and the capability to support projects ranging from complex public buildings and healthcare facilities to residential and energy\-sector developments. The region is led by Karin Stagemyr (Market area manager), Keyvan Zeidi (SAM Skövde/Alingsås) and Magnus Clase (SAM Göteborg).


Region North – Structural Engineering


Region North consists of a team of 15 structural engineers, the majority of whom have 5\-15 years of experience in the industry. The unit is located in the northern part of Sweden with offices in Östersund, Umeå, Örnsköldsvik, Mora, Lycksele and Sollefteå. Typical projects for this unit include hospitals, schools, residential and defense facilities. Clients are often public\-sector organizations such as municipalities or government organizations. The region is led by Rasmus Brink (Market area manager) and Joel Melander (SAM).

**Based on your experience and qualifications we will recognize you at the position of assistant structural designer or junior structural designer.**


Your key responsibilities

* Develop structural designs for buildings
* Perform structural calculations and analysis according to Eurocode
* Collaborate with architects and other engineers to optimize building designs
* Ensure compliance with building codes and regulations
* Prepare detailed technical drawings and specifications
* Report and follow up on own progress and budget

  

**Qualifications**  

We expect that you have

* Master's degree in Civil Engineering or Structural Engineering
* A minimum of 3 years of experience in structural design for buildings
* Proficiency in performing structural calculations both manually and using structural analysis software
* Proficiency in designing load\-bearing structures according to Eurocode
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent communication skills in English
* An unpretentious attitude, a team player, and a solution\-oriented mindset.


We appreciate if you also have

* Experience of working with projects in Sweden
* Proficiency in modelling and drawing production in Tekla or Revit
* Knowledge of Swedish

  

**Additional Information**

jobs.description:

AFRY provides engineering, design, digital and advisory services to accelerate the transition towards a sustainable society.


AFRY employs over 18,000 professionals in more than 50 countries. Net sales in 2024 were SEK 27,160 million.


AFRY is organized into three Divisions: Energy; Industry and Transportation \& Places.


The Global Division Transportation \& Places is active within transportation infrastructure, real estate, water and environment in the Nordics and Central Europe. The division has about 6,500 employees and is structured around two segments: Road \& Rail and Public \& Commercial Places.

 **Job Description**  

In Sweden we currently have 80 structural engineers working within Public and Commercial Places segment. We work with a wide scope of assignments ranging from the planning stage to execution of drawings for final production. In general, we work in teams of 10\-15 people assigned to different projects. Our engineers have a typical workload of 2\-4 ongoing projects.


Typical projects include airports, hospitals, offices, schools, public transportation facilities, high\-security facilities, defense facilities, retail developments and residential buildings.

Region East \- Structural Engineering


Region East consists of approximately 35 structural engineers located across Stockholm, Norrköping, Linköping and Motala. The region delivers structural engineering services across a broad range of sectors, including healthcare facilities, schools, airports, sports facilities, defense, residential developments, office buildings, energy facilities, and transportation/infrastructure projects. jobs.title: Advanced Software Engineer (C#/.NET)
jobs.description:
***Posting Type***

***Job Overview***

WHO WE ARE
  

Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. Our AI\-powered, cloud platform, RelativityOne, transforms massive volumes of complex information into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, data breach responses, and other high\-stakes legal work where accuracy and trust are crucial.
  

  

The world’s largest law firms, corporations, and government agencies rely on Relativity’s legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant and impactful information in their matters. Beyond our commercial impact, we are committed to expanding access to technology and supporting pro bono legal work.
  

  

WHAT WE DO
  

At Relativity, engineers don’t just write code. They harness AI tools to architect, optimize, and deliver scalable software faster while shaping the future of legal technology. They design systems that help industries uncover critical insights, ensure compliance, advance access to justice, and continuously evolve our platform using cloud\-native architectures, AI capabilities, and modern developer tooling.
  

  

Our AI helps power privacy programs, identify confidential information, and detect language indicating misconduct. We are reimagining how legal professionals uncover truth at scale, and engineering is at the heart of that transformation.
***Job Description and Requirements***

**WHAT** **YOU’LL** **DO**

* Design, develop, and operate cloud\-based services that enable organizations to manage and process data at scale across multiple platforms
* Build full\-stack features across .NET/C\# backend services, React/JavaScript frontends, and SQL data layers that support core product workflows
* Build and maintain integrations with external systems and internal platform services, including third\-party cloud data sources, notification providers, and cross\-team APIs
* Plan and execute service and data migrations, including schema changes, deployment progressions, and feature transitions in live production environments
* Apply cloud\-native patterns including containerization, event\-driven architecture, and infrastructure\-as\-code to deliver scalable and resilient services on Azure
* Manage and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and independently deploy team\-owned services
* Use observability tooling including structured logging, metrics dashboards, and distributed tracing to investigate production issues and drive system improvements
* Triage and remediate security vulnerabilities as part of the team’s ongoing security posture efforts
* Participate in on\-call rotations, contribute to incident response activities, and complete follow\-up work to support continuous improvement
* Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and adjacent teams to deliver committed sprint work on a regular cadence

**WHAT** **WE’RE** **LOOKING** **FOR**

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience
* 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience
* Proficiency in C\# and .NET, or a comparable object\-oriented language with willingness to ramp up on the stack
* Experience building and operating cloud\-based services
* Ability to work independently through complex features and debug production issues with minimal direction
* Familiarity with relational databases and SQL, including schema change management

**Preferred**

* Experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and React for full\-stack development
* Working knowledge of CI/CD pipeline tooling using GitHub Actions
* Familiarity with observability platforms such as New Relic, Grafana, or equivalent APM and logging tools
* Exposure to authentication patterns including OAuth2, OIDC, or SAML in enterprise SaaS applications
* Experience building or maintaining integrations with third\-party APIs or enterprise SaaS systems
* Familiarity with cloud\-native concepts such as containerization, event\-driven design, or infrastructure\-as\-code, with Azure experience preferred

**WHY** **WE** **COULD** **BE** **A** **GREAT** **FIT**

Impactful Mission


* Build systems that help customers organize data, discover the truth, and act on it in high\-stakes legal matters.

Engineering at Scale


* Work on distributed, cloud\-native systems that process large volumes of data.

Cutting\-Edge Technology


* Build with AI, cloud platforms, and scalable architectures shaping legal tech.

Growth and Ownership


* Gain experience owning systems end\-to\-end across cloud and distributed environments.

Collaborative Culture


* Work in a team focused on knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

Inclusive Environment


* Diverse perspectives create stronger teams and better outcomes.

Compensation and Benefits


* Competitive salary, benefits, DTO, parental leave, and equity program.
**Relativity is committed to competitive, fair, and equitable compensation practices.**

This position is eligible for total compensation which includes a competitive base salary, an annual performance bonus, and long\-term incentives.


The expected salary range for this role is between following values:


160 000 and 240 000PLN
The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate's depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, to allow for future meaningful salary growth in this position.

Engineering Principle, Hardware Integration, Innovation, Problem Solving, Process Improvements, Quality Assurance (QA), Research and Development, System Designs, Technical Documents, Troubleshooting

Beyond implementation, you will help establish engineering standards, mentor peers, and drive quality, accessibility, performance, and maintainability across a large\-scale cloud platform.

Nu söker vi på Synsam en Backend Developer som vill vara med och vidareutveckla vår digitala plattform och skapa stabila lösningar som gör skillnad för både verksamheten och våra kunder. Vi söker dig som tar stort eget ansvar, gillar att samarbeta och gärna bidrar med initiativ, kunskap och idéer som utvecklar både våra lösningar och vårt sätt att arbeta.


Hos oss blir du en viktig del av Synsams fortsatta digitala utveckling och vår ambition att vara det ledande och mest hållbara livsstilsföretaget inom optik och ögonhälsa. Du får arbeta med spännande tekniska utmaningar i en miljö där innovation, utveckling och en riktigt bra digital kundupplevelse står i fokus. Är du nyfiken på ny teknik, gillar att lösa komplexa problem och drivs av att bygga smarta och hållbara lösningar? Då kan det här vara rollen för dig!

**Om tjänsten**


Som Backend Developer blir du en del av vårt Digital Business\-team, där du tillsammans med Team Lead och kollegor inom fullstack, backend, frontend och test driver utvecklingen av Synsams e\-handelsplattform. Du arbetar med .NET, C\# och Visual Basic och är med och vidareutvecklar stabila lösningar som är en viktig del av våra kunders digitala upplevelse.


Hos oss är ensam inte stark! Du blir en del av ett framåtsträvande och sammansvetsat tvärfunktionellt team där vi samarbetar nära, delar kunskap och lär av varandra. Din närmaste chef, Pasha Ayani, arbetar även som Team Lead och tillsammans med resten av teamet driver ni utvecklingen framåt. Det här är ett team som välkomnar nya idéer, vågar testa alternativa vägar och tillsammans hittar lösningar som skapar värde för både Synsam och våra kunder.

**Ditt arbete kommer bland annat innebära:**

* Designa, utveckla och underhålla skalbara backend\-lösningar.
* Implementera och förvalta integrationer mot externa system.
* Delta i teknisk planering och scoping av initiativ.
* Säkerställa prestanda, säkerhet och stabilitet i våra tjänster.
* Sätta och upprätthålla kodstandarder, samt driva kontinuerliga förbättringar i teamets arbetsmetoder.
* Stötta teamet vid komplexa tekniska utmaningar.
* Utforska och implementera nya teknologier och verktyg för att förbättra våra processer.

**Profil**


Vi söker dig som är en erfaren backendutvecklare och som trivs med att ta ansvar, lösa komplexa problem och bygga stabila och skalbara lösningar. Du är tekniskt nyfiken och håller dig uppdaterad inom ditt område, samtidigt som du har ett pragmatiskt förhållningssätt och fokus på att skapa lösningar som fungerar i praktiken.


Du trivs i ett prestigelöst och tvärfunktionellt team där man samarbetar nära och gärna delar med sig av sin kunskap. Du har lätt för att kommunicera med både tekniska och icke\-tekniska kollegor och bidrar gärna till att utveckla såväl våra tekniska lösningar som teamets arbetssätt.

**Vi ser gärna att du har:**

* Minst 5 års arbetslivserfarenhet av backend\-utveckling.
* Stark kunskap inom .NET och C\#.
* Erfarenhet av databaser, databasdesign och optimering i MSSQL.
* Erfarenhet av molntjänster, gärna Azure, samt CI/CD.
* Vana av agila arbetsmetoder och att arbeta i tvärfunktionella team.
* Flytande svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.

**Meriterande:** Erfarenhet av frontend, eventbaserad design och API\-integrationer.

**Några ord från Pasha Ayani, Team Lead.**

*"Det bästa med att arbeta på Synsam är kombinationen av modern teknik, stort eget ansvar och möjligheten att påverka. Du blir en del av ett kompetent och prestigelöst team där vi samarbetar nära, delar kunskap och tillsammans utvecklar den digitala kundupplevelsen. När jag inte jobbar tränar jag brasiliansk jiu\-jitsu, lagar mat och umgås med familj och vänner, en bra balans som jag tycker är viktig även i arbetslivet."*

**Har vi väckt ditt intresse?**  

Vad roligt! Klicka på länken nedan och skicka in din ansökan redan idag! I vår rekryteringsprocess ingår tester, intervjuer samt referenstagning och bakgrundskontroll för slutkandidat. Rollen är en tillsvidareanställning och utgår från Synsams huvudkontor på Kungsholmen i Stockholm. Vi ser fram emot att välkomna dig till vårt team!

The role offers an opportunity to contribute ideas, solve complex problems, and support web development initiatives across larger business projects.

* At least 4–5 years of experience in web development

Nice\-to\-have skills:

* Experience with **Docker**

* Develop and maintain web\-based applications with a focus on end\-to\-end solutions

*At Avenga, everyone matters. We are committed to fostering a work environment where our diverse community of employees, candidates, and business partners actively shapes our growth. By bringing together people from different backgrounds and experiences, we build a workplace where everyone feels free to be themselves while honoring the boundaries of others.*

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Digital Manufacturing
jobs.description:
Do you want to turn digital designs into real\-world manufacturing solutions and help shape the future of production? At Sandvik Coromant in Gimo, you’re part of building smarter, more automated and data\-driven manufacturing environments.

**Why Sandvik?**  

At Sandvik Coromant, you join a market\-leading company where innovation, sustainability and development are at the core of everything we do. Here, you get to:

* Work with cutting\-edge technology in a highly automated production environment
* Collaborate globally in a diverse and inclusive organization
* Contribute to solutions that shape the future of manufacturing

**About the job**  

You develop innovative and scalable software solutions that bridge digital design and physical manufacturing. Working closely with global teams, you enable smarter and more efficient production through automation and advanced data\-driven approaches.

**Job responsibilities**

* Develop automation solutions that support the journey toward lights\-out production
* Translate product requirements into actionable shop floor solutions
* Contribute to methodologies for robust and state\-of\-the\-art software solutions
* Support CAD automation using internal domain\-specific languages
* Create seamless automation flows from design to production
* Participate in local and global projects related to new technologies and products

**Location**  

This position is based on\-site in Gimo, Sweden.

**Your profile**  

You have a strong foundation in engineering and programming, combined with an interest in manufacturing and industrial processes. Working in a global environment, you communicate effectively in both English and Swedish and enjoy collaborating across teams and disciplines.

**Your background includes:**

* Experience in programming (e.g. Python, Java, C\#)
* Knowledge of engineering, manufacturing or industrial processes
* Familiarity with areas such as CAD/CAM, product development or automation
* Understanding of modern development practices, such as agile methodologies
* Experience working with systems, architecture or data\-driven solutions
* K8s and Microservices architecture and development practices


You’re curious and analytical, with a problem\-solving mindset that drives continuous improvement. Collaboration comes naturally, and you enjoy working across teams and cultures to turn complex ideas into practical solutions. With a proactive approach, you adapt quickly to new technologies and contribute to a fast\-moving, innovative environment.

**Curious about Sandvik Coromant in Gimo?**


Sandvik Coromant in Gimo is a great place to work, just a short trip from cities like Uppsala, Stockholm and Gävle. Our production site is awarded for its high grade of automation, digitalization and sustainability. We’re also a market\-leading manufacturer of products for metal cutting, and in Gimo, we employ around 1200 brilliant minds. Development is in our DNA and we’re proud to create solutions that truly shape the future of manufacturing.


We believe that diversity of experience, perspective, and background leads to a better environment for our employees, our business, and our customers. Meet some of your future colleagues at our career page or visit our website, LinkedIn or Facebook page to get to know us further. We’re looking forward to meeting you!

We have already decided on what advertising channels and marketing campaigns we wish to use and respectfully decline any additional contacts.


Union contacts

* Henrik Eriksson, Akademikerföreningen, \+46 (0\)70\-304 88 29

**How to apply**

**Position Description**



ESB Networks is responsible for the operation, maintenance, and construction of the electricity network. We are seeking a Professional Engineer to help deliver our continuity work programmes as part of our Net Zero Strategy. We are recruiting a Professional Engineer (PE), who will work alongside the Continuity Specialist, Technical Manager and Area Managers to support the successful delivery of our continuity work programme across the central region which includes network automation, system improvements and refurbishments.

  


**Key Responsibilities**


* Developing and managing Continuity and other Network Improvement programmes in the region with the relevant stakeholders.
* Scope and high\-level concept design of Network Improvement schemes.
* Report on continuity KPIs on weekly basis (e.g. CML and CI’s).
* Produce the fault outage data on a daily \& weekly basis which includes rectification of incorrect fault data, fault reporting, investigation and follow up. Managing the regional major fault log.
* Phase Balancing studies.
* Liaise with key stakeholders – Network Assets, Operations, Network Planners, National Continuity team to deliver on region KPIs for Continuity and Network Improvement programmes.
* Assist in the preparation of budgets and work plans for master work order approvals.

jobs.title: Service Engineer
jobs.description:
**Overview**  

Make Microsoft Advertising part of your career story. Microsoft Advertising supports advertisers and partners across search, audience, retail media, commerce, and emerging AI\-powered experiences, helping businesses connect with customers across the Microsoft ecosystem. Global Support is a critical partner to customers, sales, product, and engineering teams, ensuring advertisers can adopt, operate, and optimise Microsoft Advertising solutions with confidence. As a Service Engineer, you will provide advanced technical support for complex platform and customer issues, using telemetry, diagnostics, data analysis, automation, and AI\-assisted tools to investigate root cause, restore service health, and improve the customer experience. You will partner closely with engineering and business stakeholders to turn customer signals into product improvements, scalable troubleshooting guidance, proactive monitoring, and readiness for new features. This role is ideal for someone who combines technical curiosity, solid judgement, customer empathy, and a bias for continuous improvement in a fast\-moving digital advertising environment.


Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.


Starting January 26, 2026, Microsoft AI (MAI) employees who live within a 50\- mile commute of a designated Microsoft office in the U.S. or 25\-mile commute of a non\-U.S., country\-specific location are expected to work from the office at least four days per week. This expectation is subject to local law and may vary by jurisdiction.

 **Responsibilities**  

* Investigate and resolve complex Microsoft Advertising product, escalation, policy, fraud, and service health issues using telemetry, logs, customer signals, ticket trends, and platform diagnostics to isolate root cause and validate resolution quality.
* Apply an automation\-first mindset to identify repeatable manual work, recurring issue patterns, and high\-volume support scenarios that can be simplified, standardized, scripted, or automated. Design, improve, and maintain automation, dashboards, proactive checks, alerting signals, diagnostic workflows, and AI\-assisted support tools that reduce manual troubleshooting, improve consistency, and accelerate issue resolution.
* Own complex customer, partner, sales, and support escalations by balancing urgency, quality, business impact, SLA expectations, and technical evidence while keeping stakeholders informed through clear and timely communication. Drive root cause analysis and service improvement in partnership with Product and Engineering, ensuring fixes, mitigations, tooling gaps, automation opportunities, and supportability improvements are prioritized, validated, and landed effectively.
* Create and maintain scalable support assets, including diagnostic playbooks, troubleshooting guides, knowledge base articles, escalation templates, and readiness content that enable teams to resolve issues consistently.
* Measure and improve support effectiveness through indicators such as reduced manual effort, faster triage, improved MTTR, fewer repeat contacts, fewer unnecessary escalations, more solid SLA stability, and improved customer support quality.
* Act as the voice of the customer and support organization by providing actionable feedback to Product, Engineering, Account Management, Support leadership, and Trust and Safety stakeholders on customer experience, supportability gaps, operational risk, and automation opportunities. Participate in operational coverage, including occasional night and weekend on\-call support, to maintain service health, timely escalation response, and continuity for critical monitoring or automation workflows.

  

**Qualifications** **Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Data Science, Cybersecurity, or related field AND technical experience in software engineering, network engineering, service engineering, systems engineering, or industrial controls
	+ OR equivalent experience.

**Other Requirements:**  

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

* **Microsoft Cloud Background Check:** This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Data Science, Cybersecurity, or related field AND technical experience in software engineering, network engineering, service engineering, systems engineering, or industrial controls
	+ OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Data Science, Cybersecurity, or related field AND technical experience in software engineering, network engineering, service engineering, systems engineering, or industrial controls
	+ OR equivalent experience.
* Technical experience in service engineering, software engineering, systems engineering, technical support, or a comparable engineering environment supporting online services, commercial platforms, or cloud services.
* Experience in customer\-facing Tier 3 technical support, escalation management, live\-site operations, or advanced troubleshooting for high\-volume commercial platforms or cloud services.
* Experience designing, building, or improving automation, scripts, diagnostic workflows, dashboards, proactive checks, or alerting solutions that reduce manual effort and improve operational efficiency.
* Proficiency with one or more programming or scripting languages such as Python, C\#, JavaScript, PowerShell, Java, or similar languages used for automation, tooling, data analysis, or troubleshooting.
* Experience querying, analyzing, and visualizing large datasets using SQL or equivalent data platforms to identify trends, validate hypotheses, measure support impact, and generate actionable insights.
* Experience working with cloud, distributed systems, telemetry, monitoring, observability, or service health tooling, preferably in Azure or comparable cloud environments.
* Experience troubleshooting or integrating with modern web and API technologies, including REST, JSON, XML, authentication patterns, and related data exchange or platform integration scenarios.
* Experience using AI\-assisted tools, Copilot\-style workflows, or emerging automation capabilities to improve triage, investigation, summarization, knowledge discovery, or support productivity.
* Solid written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical issues clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences, including customers, partners, engineering teams, and leadership stakeholders.
* Solid documentation and knowledge\-management skills, including experience producing troubleshooting guides, diagnostic playbooks, case notes, bug reports, readiness materials, or technical training content.
* Ability to collaborate across remote, global, and cross\-functional teams, influence through technical evidence, and operate effectively in ambiguous situations with solid ownership and judgement.
* Experience with Microsoft Advertising, ad tech, search, audience, retail media, display, video, reporting, conversion tracking, trust and safety, fraud, policy, or digital advertising support scenarios.

jobs.description:
Tieto Banktech


1360 Fornebu


**Om jobben**
-------------


Lagre favoritt


Stillingstittel
DevOps SW Engineer for Specialised Lending
Type ansettelse
Fast, heltid 100%
Antall stillinger
1
Arbeidsspråk
Engelsk
Vis flere detaljer

  

We are looking for a DevOps SW Engineer who wants to be part of Tieto Banktech. Tieto Banktech powers some of the Nordics’ most trusted banking systems with secure, reliable, and scalable solutions. Using automation, data, AI, and cloud, supported by hands\-on guidance, we help banks modernize their core, strengthen trust, and deliver greater impact across the banking experience.


SLS (Specialised Lending System) is a mission\-critical loan, guarantee and collateral management solution used by banks and export credit agencies. The platform supports complex corporate lending products and end\-to\-end processes across case handling, integrations, batch/settlement flows and regulatory\-driven operations. SLS is primarily Microsoft\-based (C\#/.NET, SQL Server, IIS) with web/UI and service integration components, and it is operated across multiple customer and internal environments with high requirements for stability, traceability and security.


We are looking for a DevOps / Software Engineer who can take end\-to\-end ownership of how SLS is built, packaged, released and operated. You will work closely with development teams, architects, and operations (AO) to improve CI/CD pipelines, automate environment provisioning, strengthen release governance, and increase production robustness through better monitoring, runbooks and proactive maintenance. You thrive in dynamic environments and collaborate effectively with clients and colleagues. You enjoy working with varied and complex tasks, and you collaborate well in teams to find the best solutions.


**Work tasks will be among other things:**

jobs.title: .NET-udvikler til Product Engineering
jobs.description:
Vi søger en backend\-udvikler til Product Engineering, der har lyst til at være med fra bunden – og som samtidig kan bygge løsninger, der holder, når belastningen topper.


Du bliver en del af et team, hvor app og backend arbejder som ét hold. Her er der kort fra idé til kode, og du får mandat til at træffe de arkitekturvalg, der skal bære os de næste mange år.

**Om jobbet**


Som .NET\-udvikler sidder du tæt på både app\-udviklerne, produktet og forretningen. Du kommer blandt andet til at:

* Designe og udvikle skalerbare, sikre og hurtige API’er i C\# og moderne .NET
* Bygge det arkitektoniske fundament, der skal drive fremtidens spiloplevelser
* Sikre fremdrift i app\-teamet med mock\-API’er og prototyper, mens den robuste løsning modnes
* Bruge moderne AI\-kodeværktøjer til at effektivisere boilerplate, test og optimering
* Sikre driftssikkerhed og performance i løsninger, der skal klare ekstreme spidsbelastninger

**Om dig**


Vi forestiller os, at du genkender dig selv i flere af nedenstående punkter:

* **Dyb .NET\-ekspertise:** Du er en stærk håndværker i C\# og moderne .NET, og du forstår at bygge skalerbare, sikre og lynhurtige API’er.
* **Frontend\-empati:** Du forstår, at dit API er fundamentet for app\-oplevelsen. Du tænker over latency og smarte payloads og bygger API’er, der gør livet let og hurtigt for den iOS\-udvikler, der skal konsumere dem.
* **Pragmatisk fremdrift:** Du kender vigtigheden af at sikre fremdrift for dine aftagere. Du leverer hurtigt mock\-API’er og prototyper, der sikrer fremdrift, mens du bygger den langsigtede og robuste arkitektur under kølerhjelmen.
* **Agentic AI\-kompetence:** Du har praktisk erfaring med – eller stor nysgerrighed for – at udnytte agentic workflows, prompt engineering og AI\-værktøjer til at accelerere din kode\- og udviklingsproces.
* **Product Engineer\-mindset:** Du tænker som en Product Engineer. Du koder ikke bare kravspecifikationer, men engagerer dig i brugerrejsen og forretningsværdien.

**Om Product Engineering**


Product Engineering er produktfokuseret, eksekverende, samarbejdsorienteret, autonom og ambitiøs. Vi bygger for brugeren frem for systemets skyld, vi arbejder som ét team på tværs af app og backend, og vi har mandatet til selv at træffe de rigtige arkitekturvalg. Ambitionen er driftssikre løsninger, der kan håndtere massiv skala.

**Hvorfor Danske Spil?**


Hos Danske Spil får du en ret unik mulighed: startup\-viben ved at være med til at bygge et nyt, stærkt in\-house app\-udviklingsmiljø op fra bunden – men med skalaen, tyngden og volumen fra en af Danmarks største digitale forretninger.


Som backend\-udvikler i Product Engineering bliver du ikke gemt væk i en silo. Du sidder helt tæt på app\-udviklerne og forretningen og får direkte indflydelse på det arkitektoniske fundament, der skal drive fremtidens spiloplevelser. Du arbejder agilt og autonomt med moderne, AI\-støttede værktøjer. Det er den perfekte legeplads, hvis du motiveres af at bygge API’er, der både kræver høj fart og innovation i hverdagen, og som samtidig skal kunne klare ekstreme spidsbelastninger uden at blinke.

**Vil du være med til at underholde danskerne?**


Vi læser ansøgninger igennem løbende, men deadline for at søge er den 9\. oktober 2026\. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Jesper Persson på jepe@danskespil.dk. Hvis du har spørgsmål til rekrutteringsprocessen, er du velkommen til at kontakte HR Business Partner, Mette Overgaard Holm på MEHO@danskespil.dk.

jobs.title: Backend Software Developer - Team Sports Applications
jobs.description:
***Do you want to develop cutting\-edge software applications for our world\-leading products? Looking to use and grow your development skills in a fast\-paced and creative environment? If this sounds like an exciting challenge, we’d love to hear from you!***

**About the job**


Trackman products generate extremely accurate measurements using a patented combination of camera and radar, which provide valuable insights for athletes ranging from top worldclass professionals to enthusiastic amateurs, as well as coaches, scouts, and clubs of all levels.


As part of our company's continued expansion, we are looking for a .NET C\# backend developer. You will join a department of 45\+ skilled developers, responsible for applications used in golf, baseball, softball and football. You will be part of refinement, planning, implementation, testing and deployment to our customers.


We build applications hosted on distributed Linux servers running Docker, on Microsoft Azure technologies, on mobile devices and customer laptops. You will get to interact with skilled developers working across a range of platforms and apps. We always work with the latest LTS .NET version using C\# with web frontends in React.


As part of our development toolkit, our teams actively use AI\-assisted tools such as GitHub Copilot and Claude to speed up coding, testing, and documentation — letting our developers spend more time on solving interesting problems and less on repetitive tasks.


You will join a team of skilled developers who love what they do and, in a role, where you can have a big impact both on what is being built and how it is built. We value having our developers being part of refinement and you will be deeply involved in finding great solutions from a technical as well as a user perspective together with our Head of Products and UI/UX designers.

 **Required skills:**

* 3\+ years of working with .NET and excellent C\# programming skills
* Professional usage of an IDE like Visual Studio or Rider
* Work in an agile environment with a strong focus on collaboration, knowledge sharing, and clear communication
* Good understanding of architectural patterns and software design principles
* Good communication skills and a positive and proactive mindset
* Experience with Git

**Additional skills (not required, but nice to have):**

* Experience with using AI\-assisted development tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude)
* Experience with Docker and Azure Pipelines


All we ask is that you bring passion, curiosity and structure to our workplace. We are a company of many nationalities. Whether you are from abroad or already living in Denmark, we welcome talented people of any gender, nationality and belief. We think the right mix of people makes for the best culture and product.


At Trackman, we see AI not as a replacement for great developers, but as a tool that makes great developers even more effective — accelerating code reviews, catching bugs earlier, and freeing up time for the creative problem\-solving that moves our products forward.


The IT landscape is evolving faster than ever and staying up to date with AI\-assisted development is quickly becoming a fundamental part of the software development process.

**The Office**


We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state\-of\-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

**Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one\-of\-a\-kind technology**


Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting\-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.


Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.


We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000\+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.


**Where innovation happens**


At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.


**Share our Passion!**


Applications are continuously assessed, so please send your application as soon as possible.

jobs.title: AI Reimagination Engineer
jobs.description:
**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.**


Join an inclusive team passionate about one thing: using their expertise in the relentless pursuit of innovation for customers and partners. The solutions we build help make everything from virtual reality experiences to breakthroughs in neural networks possible. We do it all while committing to integrity, sustainability, and giving back to our communities. Because doing so can fuel the very innovation we are pursuing.

**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for** ***all*****.**

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.


As an AI Reimagination Engineer in Micron's Generative AI Center of Excellence (GenAI COE), you have an outstanding chance to transform how businesses function. You will partner with different business areas to break down large, manual, multi\-step processes and redesign them into effective, autonomous systems. This position combines process reimagination with AI systems engineering, making you a key part of the transformation journey. You will collaborate closely with the GenAI COE, IT architecture, security, and project teams. You will lead projects from the initial redesign to the final build, delivering solutions that business teams can adopt and scale.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Decompose end\-to\-end processes: Map current\-state flows, quantify effort and risk, and lead eliminate/simplify/agentify analysis before automation.
* Architect the agentic solution: Build future\-state flows and AI architecture, including task and agent decomposition, orchestration patterns, tool and data access, memory and context strategy, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls.
* Translate inventions into buildable solutions by developing agent workflows, composing prompt and context strategies, MCP/connector and integration requirements, and evaluation criteria. Follow Micron's “Secure by Design” and data\-classification standards.
* Prototype and build: Construct working agentic solutions, or direct their build with platform engineers, validating fit and value prior to full delivery.
* Engineer trust and control: Define testable human\-in\-the\-loop controls and least\-privilege permissions for each process step.
* Drive multi\-functional delivery: Collaborate across the client function, IT architecture, security, platform engineers, and the Enterprise Project Management Office (EPMO) through first production release.
* Measure value and codify patterns: Capture value baselines during discovery, support 30/90\-day post\-release measurement, and turn findings into reference flows, decomposition patterns, and playbooks. Mentor engineers and grow the network of agentic champions.

**Minimum Qualifications:**
---------------------------

* Education: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, AI/ML, engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience blending technical delivery with business process work.
* Hybrid Experience: Proven track record in both decomposing complex business processes and crafting or building technical solutions.
* Agentic Delivery: 8\+ years of overall experience and 3\+ years in AI/ML. Recently, hands\-on experience building agentic or LLM\-based systems.

**Preferred Qualifications:**
-----------------------------

* Process Redesign: Experience leading workshop\-based process redesign and translating findings into requirements. Familiar with AI governance, responsible\-AI, security fundamentals, and validation/testing strategies for autonomous behavior.
* Technical Proficiency: Hands\-on experience with enterprise AI and automation platforms, and proficiency across Python, .NET/C\#, SQL, and APIs. Depth in agent orchestration and multi\-agent development, context management, and long\-horizon tasks.
* Communication: Excellent facilitation, written, and executive interpersonal skills. Proficient in running discovery with business leaders and driving alignment across business, engineering, and risk teams.

**About Micron Technology, Inc.**


We are an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life *for all*. With a relentless focus on our customers, technology leadership, and manufacturing and operational excellence, Micron delivers a rich portfolio of high\-performance DRAM, NAND, and NOR memory and storage products through our Micron® and Crucial® brands. Every day, the innovations that our people create fuel the data economy, enabling advances in artificial intelligence and 5G applications that unleash opportunities — from the data center to the intelligent edge and across the client and mobile user experience.  

  

To learn more, please visit micron.com/careers  

  

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.  

  

To request assistance with the application process and/or for reasonable accommodations, please contact hrsupport\_sg@micron.com


Micron Prohibits the use of child labor and complies with all applicable laws, rules, regulations, and other international and industry labor standards.


Micron does not charge candidates any recruitment fees or unlawfully collect any other payment from candidates as consideration for their employment with Micron.


AI alert: Candidates are encouraged to use AI tools to enhance their resume and/or application materials. However, all information provided must be accurate and reflect the candidate's true skills and experiences. Misuse of AI to fabricate or misrepresent qualifications will result in immediate disqualification.


Fraud alert: Micron advises job seekers to be cautious of unsolicited job offers and to verify the authenticity of any communication claiming to be from Micron by checking the official Micron careers website in the About Micron Technology, Inc.

* Veri Bilimi / Veri Mühendisliği

Açık öğretim ve mezun başvuruları kabul edilmemektedir.

* Mezun olanlar veya staj zorunluluğu bulunmayanlar
* Yukarıda belirtilen bölümler dışında okuyanlar
* Açık öğretim öğrencileri
* Python'da temel seviyede kod yazamayanlar

* Deadline ve revize kültürüne uzak olanlar

* LLM tabanlı AI agent'ların kurgulanması ve geliştirilmesi

* RAG (retrieval\-augmented generation) mantığıyla içerik ve veri işleme
* Gerçek projelerde hata ayıklama, ölçümleme ve iyileştirme süreçlerine katılım

**Bilmen Artıdır (Zorunlu Değil)**

* Python (temel seviye yeterli)
* REST API ve JSON mantığı
* LangChain, LlamaIndex veya benzeri agent framework'leri
* Git / GitHub kullanımı
* Vektör veritabanları (Pinecone, Chroma, Supabase vb.)
* İngilizce teknik doküman okuyabilecek seviye

Bunların hiçbiri yoksa ama hızlı öğrenebileceğine güveniyorsan başvurabilirsin.

**Çalışma Şekli**

* Hibrit: haftanın belirli günleri Kurtköy'deki ofiste, kalan günler uzaktan
* Esnek saatler, net sorumluluklar, gerçek deadline'lar
* Staj süresi ve haftalık gün sayısı okulunuzun staj takvimine göre planlanır

**Sana Ne Kazandırır?**

* Gerçek projelerde AI agent geliştirme deneyimi
* GitHub'da gösterilebilir, portföy değeri taşıyan işler
* Performansa bağlı uzun vadeli ekip ve ücretli çalışma ihtimali
* Profesyonel üretim disiplinini doğrudan öğrenme fırsatı

**Başvuru Şekli**

Başvurularda aşağıdakiler istenir:

* Kısa bir kendini tanıtma metni
* Üniversite, bölüm ve sınıf bilgisi

* Varsa GitHub profili veya daha önce geliştirdiğiniz projeler

Uygun görülen adaylara küçük bir deneme görevi verilecektir.

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Kurtköy
