As a Service Engineer, you will provide advanced technical support for complex platform and customer issues, using telemetry, diagnostics, data analysis, automation, and AI\-assisted tools to investigate root cause, restore service health, and improve the customer experience. You will partner closely with engineering and business stakeholders to turn customer signals into product improvements, scalable troubleshooting guidance, proactive monitoring, and readiness for new features. This role is ideal for someone who combines technical curiosity, solid judgement, customer empathy, and a bias for continuous improvement in a fast\-moving digital advertising environment.


Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Design, improve, and maintain automation, dashboards, proactive checks, alerting signals, diagnostic workflows, and AI\-assisted support tools that reduce manual troubleshooting, improve consistency, and accelerate issue resolution.

new_jobs.title: .NET-udvikler til Product Engineering
new_jobs.description:
Vi søger en backend\-udvikler til Product Engineering, der har lyst til at være med fra bunden – og som samtidig kan bygge løsninger, der holder, når belastningen topper.


Du bliver en del af et team, hvor app og backend arbejder som ét hold. Her er der kort fra idé til kode, og du får mandat til at træffe de arkitekturvalg, der skal bære os de næste mange år.

**Om jobbet**


Som .NET\-udvikler sidder du tæt på både app\-udviklerne, produktet og forretningen. Du kommer blandt andet til at:

* Designe og udvikle skalerbare, sikre og hurtige API’er i C\# og moderne .NET
* Bygge det arkitektoniske fundament, der skal drive fremtidens spiloplevelser
* Sikre fremdrift i app\-teamet med mock\-API’er og prototyper, mens den robuste løsning modnes
* Bruge moderne AI\-kodeværktøjer til at effektivisere boilerplate, test og optimering
* Sikre driftssikkerhed og performance i løsninger, der skal klare ekstreme spidsbelastninger

**Om dig**


Vi forestiller os, at du genkender dig selv i flere af nedenstående punkter:

* **Dyb .NET\-ekspertise:** Du er en stærk håndværker i C\# og moderne .NET, og du forstår at bygge skalerbare, sikre og lynhurtige API’er.
* **Frontend\-empati:** Du forstår, at dit API er fundamentet for app\-oplevelsen. Du tænker over latency og smarte payloads og bygger API’er, der gør livet let og hurtigt for den iOS\-udvikler, der skal konsumere dem.
* **Pragmatisk fremdrift:** Du kender vigtigheden af at sikre fremdrift for dine aftagere. Du leverer hurtigt mock\-API’er og prototyper, der sikrer fremdrift, mens du bygger den langsigtede og robuste arkitektur under kølerhjelmen.
* **Agentic AI\-kompetence:** Du har praktisk erfaring med – eller stor nysgerrighed for – at udnytte agentic workflows, prompt engineering og AI\-værktøjer til at accelerere din kode\- og udviklingsproces.
* **Product Engineer\-mindset:** Du tænker som en Product Engineer. Du koder ikke bare kravspecifikationer, men engagerer dig i brugerrejsen og forretningsværdien.

**Om Product Engineering**


Product Engineering er produktfokuseret, eksekverende, samarbejdsorienteret, autonom og ambitiøs. Vi bygger for brugeren frem for systemets skyld, vi arbejder som ét team på tværs af app og backend, og vi har mandatet til selv at træffe de rigtige arkitekturvalg. Ambitionen er driftssikre løsninger, der kan håndtere massiv skala.

**Hvorfor Danske Spil?**


Hos Danske Spil får du en ret unik mulighed: startup\-viben ved at være med til at bygge et nyt, stærkt in\-house app\-udviklingsmiljø op fra bunden – men med skalaen, tyngden og volumen fra en af Danmarks største digitale forretninger.


Som backend\-udvikler i Product Engineering bliver du ikke gemt væk i en silo. Du sidder helt tæt på app\-udviklerne og forretningen og får direkte indflydelse på det arkitektoniske fundament, der skal drive fremtidens spiloplevelser. Du arbejder agilt og autonomt med moderne, AI\-støttede værktøjer. Det er den perfekte legeplads, hvis du motiveres af at bygge API’er, der både kræver høj fart og innovation i hverdagen, og som samtidig skal kunne klare ekstreme spidsbelastninger uden at blinke.

**Vil du være med til at underholde danskerne?**


Vi læser ansøgninger igennem løbende, men deadline for at søge er den 9\. oktober 2026\. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Jesper Persson på jepe@danskespil.dk. Hvis du har spørgsmål til rekrutteringsprocessen, er du velkommen til at kontakte HR Business Partner, Mette Overgaard Holm på MEHO@danskespil.dk.

new_jobs.title: AI Reimagination Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.**


Join an inclusive team passionate about one thing: using their expertise in the relentless pursuit of innovation for customers and partners. The solutions we build help make everything from virtual reality experiences to breakthroughs in neural networks possible. We do it all while committing to integrity, sustainability, and giving back to our communities. Because doing so can fuel the very innovation we are pursuing.

**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for** ***all*****.**

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.


As an AI Reimagination Engineer in Micron's Generative AI Center of Excellence (GenAI COE), you have an outstanding chance to transform how businesses function. You will partner with different business areas to break down large, manual, multi\-step processes and redesign them into effective, autonomous systems. This position combines process reimagination with AI systems engineering, making you a key part of the transformation journey. You will collaborate closely with the GenAI COE, IT architecture, security, and project teams. You will lead projects from the initial redesign to the final build, delivering solutions that business teams can adopt and scale.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Decompose end\-to\-end processes: Map current\-state flows, quantify effort and risk, and lead eliminate/simplify/agentify analysis before automation.
* Architect the agentic solution: Build future\-state flows and AI architecture, including task and agent decomposition, orchestration patterns, tool and data access, memory and context strategy, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls.
* Translate inventions into buildable solutions by developing agent workflows, composing prompt and context strategies, MCP/connector and integration requirements, and evaluation criteria. Follow Micron's “Secure by Design” and data\-classification standards.
* Prototype and build: Construct working agentic solutions, or direct their build with platform engineers, validating fit and value prior to full delivery.
* Engineer trust and control: Define testable human\-in\-the\-loop controls and least\-privilege permissions for each process step.
* Drive multi\-functional delivery: Collaborate across the client function, IT architecture, security, platform engineers, and the Enterprise Project Management Office (EPMO) through first production release.
* Measure value and codify patterns: Capture value baselines during discovery, support 30/90\-day post\-release measurement, and turn findings into reference flows, decomposition patterns, and playbooks. Mentor engineers and grow the network of agentic champions.

**Minimum Qualifications:**
---------------------------

* Education: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, AI/ML, engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience blending technical delivery with business process work.
* Hybrid Experience: Proven track record in both decomposing complex business processes and crafting or building technical solutions.
* Agentic Delivery: 8\+ years of overall experience and 3\+ years in AI/ML. Recently, hands\-on experience building agentic or LLM\-based systems.

**Preferred Qualifications:**
-----------------------------

* Process Redesign: Experience leading workshop\-based process redesign and translating findings into requirements. Familiar with AI governance, responsible\-AI, security fundamentals, and validation/testing strategies for autonomous behavior.
* Technical Proficiency: Hands\-on experience with enterprise AI and automation platforms, and proficiency across Python, .NET/C\#, SQL, and APIs. Depth in agent orchestration and multi\-agent development, context management, and long\-horizon tasks.
* Communication: Excellent facilitation, written, and executive interpersonal skills. Proficient in running discovery with business leaders and driving alignment across business, engineering, and risk teams.

**About Micron Technology, Inc.**


We are an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life *for all*. With a relentless focus on our customers, technology leadership, and manufacturing and operational excellence, Micron delivers a rich portfolio of high\-performance DRAM, NAND, and NOR memory and storage products through our Micron® and Crucial® brands. Every day, the innovations that our people create fuel the data economy, enabling advances in artificial intelligence and 5G applications that unleash opportunities — from the data center to the intelligent edge and across the client and mobile user experience.  

  

To learn more, please visit micron.com/careers  

  

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.  

  

To request assistance with the application process and/or for reasonable accommodations, please contact hrsupport\_sg@micron.com


Micron Prohibits the use of child labor and complies with all applicable laws, rules, regulations, and other international and industry labor standards.


Micron does not charge candidates any recruitment fees or unlawfully collect any other payment from candidates as consideration for their employment with Micron.


AI alert: Candidates are encouraged to use AI tools to enhance their resume and/or application materials. However, all information provided must be accurate and reflect the candidate's true skills and experiences. Misuse of AI to fabricate or misrepresent qualifications will result in immediate disqualification.


Fraud alert: Micron advises job seekers to be cautious of unsolicited job offers and to verify the authenticity of any communication claiming to be from Micron by checking the official Micron careers website in the About Micron Technology, Inc.

new_jobs.title: Stage / TFE – Développeur C#
new_jobs.description:
**DevTeix** est une société dynamique d'une dizaine de personnes qui développe, depuis plus de 30 ans, des logiciels sur mesure pour l'industrie. Elle commercialise notamment des logiciels de gestion de production (GPAO) destinés aux usines de charpentes métalliques et de bois lamellé\-collé : Steel Manager et Wood Manager. Les bureaux de DevTeix sont situés dans le zoning industriel des Hauts\-Sarts, à Herstal.

**Wood Manager**, l'application la plus récente de DevTeix, est développée entièrement en C\# et utilisée quotidiennement en atelier pour piloter la production de poutres en bois lamellé\-collé, depuis la réception des pièces jusqu'à leur mise en presse pour le collage. Une étape centrale de cette production est le plan de serrage : une fenêtre dans laquelle l'opérateur dispose, oriente et ajuste les poutres qui seront collées ensemble, via une visionneuse 3D (Eyeshot).

Cette fenêtre propose de nombreuses actions qui, une fois effectuées, sont directement enregistrées en base de données. Le revers de cet enregistrement immédiat : il n'existe aujourd'hui aucun moyen de revenir en arrière, et la moindre erreur de manipulation oblige l'opérateur à corriger la situation manuellement.

Votre mission sera de développer un véritable système d'annulation et de rétablissement (Ctrl\+Z / Ctrl\+Y) pour cette fenêtre. Cela demande de bien comprendre le fonctionnement actuel du plan de serrage et l'ensemble de ses actions, puis de concevoir une structure (par exemple basée sur le patron de conception Command) capable, pour chaque type d'action, de mémoriser les informations nécessaires pour la rejouer ou l'inverser, et d'intégrer cette structure aux traitements existants. Certains cas demanderont une attention particulière, comme les opérations qui génèrent de nouvelles poutres en base (délignage, reprise, aboutage), à annuler proprement sans laisser de données orphelines. Vous réfléchirez aussi à la présentation de cette fonctionnalité à l'utilisateur : raccourcis clavier, boutons, retours visuels clairs.

**Stack technique :** C\#, DevExpress, Eyeshot, SQL Server, EF Core. Aucune connaissance préalable de ces outils n'est requise. La connaissance d'un langage orienté objet (C\#, Java, C\+\+...) ainsi que quelques notions de bases de données sont un plus.

Le stage se déroule en partie sur site à Herstal et en partie à distance (une connexion internet à domicile est nécessaire). Matériel et licences sont fournis par DevTeix. Durée minimale de 3 mois, prolongeable à la demande de l'étudiant, avec un début flexible. Vous serez encadré par un responsable de projet et un développeur DevTeix, et un référent académique est le bienvenu.

Pour candidater, contactez José Teixeira, Executive Director, par mail à j.teixeira@vvtw.be ou par téléphone au \+32 487 41 91 20\.

Avantages :

* Ordinateur de fonction
* Travail à domicile

Lieu du poste : En présentiel

We work hard for the people who work for us. We champion our teams and foster collaboration, inclusion, respect and excellence. Because **we want to be more for you.**

--------------------


Design, develop, and maintain industrial software applications using C\# (.NET) and Python.

Develop multi\-threaded and asynchronous applications for real\-time image acquisition, processing, and data management.
  

Integrate software with industrial hardware, including cameras, PLCs, and field devices using standard industrial communication protocols.
  

Optimize application performance, focusing on latency, throughput, reliability, and memory efficiency in 24/7 production environments.
  

Design and maintain data persistence solutions and database integrations to support traceability and production reporting.
  

Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver and support automation, AI, and manufacturing solutions.
  

Participate in code reviews, maintain source control using Git, and contribute to testing and CI/CD practices.
  

Support software commissioning, deployment, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement at manufacturing and customer sites.
  

Create and maintain technical documentation and share knowledge across engineering teams.

---------------------------


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience.

Proficiency in C\# (.NET) and Python, including object\-oriented design and asynchronous programming.
  

Experience with software architecture, design patterns, UML modeling, concurrent programming, and performance optimization.
  

Experience with Git, relational databases (PostgreSQL or SQL Server), and collaborative software development practices.
